Expert Insights on Living and Investing in Punta Sur, Akumal
------------------------------------------------------------

Local advisor perspectives on what it is like to live and invest in this sought-after neighborhood.

![Elizabeth Gregg](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Eli-Gregg.jpg)

Elizabeth Gregg•Luxury Broker

> Punta Sur is a small private beachfront community located between Akumal and Tulum, directly across from the Tulum Country Club. After years working in this market and selling several properties in the area, it remains one of my favorite locations along this stretch of coastline.
> 
> The community is located about the same distance from Cancun International Airport and Tulum International Airport, which makes travel convenient for owners and guests. It is also about 25 minutes north of the Tulum hotel zone and roughly 30 minutes south of Playa del Carmen Centro, placing it in a very central location.
> 
> One of Punta Sur’s biggest advantages is the ocean conditions. The coastal currents in this area tend to push sargassum away from the shoreline, so the beachfront often has clearer water and wide open Caribbean views.
> 
> The immediate shoreline is mostly rocky, which helps keep the water clear. However, sandy beaches are only minutes away. Aventuras Akumal beach is about a five minute walk to the north, while Akumal Sur’s sandy shoreline is about five minutes to the south along the Akumal walking trail.
> 
> Another major benefit is infrastructure. Punta Sur is one of the few beachfront communities in the region with municipal water service, which is a significant advantage for long term ownership.

#### Property Description

Punta Sur 5 is a premier oceanfront villa in Akumal, offering a private retreat with breathtaking Caribbean views and sophisticated design. Situated on a 1,400 m² (15,064 ft²) lot, this expansive 1,187 m² (12,768 ft²) villa is a showcase of luxury, seamlessly blending contemporary architecture with the natural beauty of Punta Sur.

Designed for both relaxation and entertainment, the residence features nine spacious bedrooms, each providing privacy and comfort. A flexible floor plan allows for an additional tenth bedroom if desired. The nine spa-inspired bathrooms and guest powder room are elegantly finished with high-end materials, creating a refined atmosphere throughout the home.

Outdoor living is a highlight, with a stunning infinity-edge pool, a whirlpool, and a private beach bar. Multiple shaded lounge areas and a rooftop terrace offer ideal spaces for entertaining or enjoying the serene coastal views.

Equipped with CFE electricity, CAPA water, high-speed fiber-optic internet, and an eco-friendly wetlands sewage system, the estate ensures modern convenience while maintaining a commitment to sustainability.

Located near Akumal’s pristine beaches, luxury dining, and world-class golf resorts, Punta Sur 5 is an exceptional opportunity for those seeking privacy, exclusivity, and a refined beachfront lifestyle in the Riviera Maya.

#### About Me

Jorge Delgado, Sales Manager, and real estate expert specializes in residential properties throughout Akumal, Playa del Carmen, Puerto Aventuras, Puerto Morelos, and Tulum. Originally from Baja California, Jorge’s passion for architecture and real estate has shaped his career and brought him to the stunning paradise of Tulum, where he has lived for the past several years.

After graduating with a degree in Architecture in Monterrey, Jorge began his career in a commercial real estate firm specializing in market studies for new developments. This experience gave him valuable insights into the planning and execution of large-scale commercial projects, laying the foundation for his expertise in real estate.

Driven by a lifelong dream to build his home on the beach, Jorge relocated to Tulum to focus on residential real estate. His dedication to helping others achieve their goals reflects his belief that supporting others leads to surpassing one’s aspirations. With a deep appreciation for Tulum’s natural beauty, cultural diversity, and innovative architecture, Jorge takes pride in connecting clients to the region’s unique opportunities.

Jorge’s approach combines professionalism, market knowledge, and a genuine enthusiasm for helping clients find their dream homes in paradise. Whether you’re exploring Tulum’s vibrant real estate market or the surrounding Riviera Maya, Jorge Delgado is ready to guide you with expertise and care. Reach out to learn more about the unparalleled opportunities in this extraordinary region.

#### Property Description

Tucked away in Tulum Casa Arka is an architectural masterpiece that redefines luxury. This exquisite nine-bedroom, eleven-bathroom estate spans an impressive 9,332 sq. ft, offering an unparalleled blend of natural beauty, sophisticated design, and five-star amenities. Located just five minutes from the beach, within an exclusive, gated community with 24/7 security, Casa Arka provides the utmost privacy and tranquility.

Designed to captivate the senses, this fully furnished residence harmonizes organic materials with sleek contemporary elegance. Expansive living spaces seamlessly transition between indoor and outdoor sanctuaries, where cascading waterfalls, lush Zen gardens, and soaring ceilings create an atmosphere of serenity.

Indulge in two stunning pools, a private 16-person heated jacuzzi, and a breathtaking rooftop infinity pool with unmatched 360° jungle views. Entertain effortlessly with a private cinema, an opulent fire lounge, an exquisite bar, and lavish cabana lounges. Thoughtfully curated features like roll-out outdoor beds, an indoor rainfall installation, and a rooftop firepit elevate this estate to an unparalleled level of grandeur.

#### Property Description

Set within the prestigious Costa Residences & Beach Club, this extraordinary six-bedroom beachfront condo redefines luxury living in the heart of the Riviera Maya. Located inside Corasol, the region’s most sought-after private gated community, this stunning residence offers a seamless blend of modern sophistication, coastal serenity, and exclusive resort-style amenities just steps from the soft white sands of the Caribbean Sea.

Designed by the renowned CUAIK Arquitectos, this two-level Pentgarden residence is a true architectural masterpiece. It offers an expansive 4811 square feet (447 square meters) of elegantly appointed interior space, complemented by 4445 square feet (413 square meters) of stunning outdoor terraces, creating an impressive total of 9256 square feet (860 square meters) of seamless indoor-outdoor living. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame breathtaking ocean views, while the open-concept design invites natural light to flow throughout, enhancing the sense of space and connection to the tropical surroundings.

Every detail of this luxurious beachfront home has been carefully curated to provide an elevated lifestyle. The chef’s kitchen is outfitted with high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and sleek countertops, making it an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. The primary suite is a private retreat with its own ocean-view terrace and a spa-like ensuite bath designed for ultimate relaxation. Additional bedrooms offer equally impressive finishes, spacious layouts, and private bathrooms, ensuring that every resident and guest enjoys the pinnacle of comfort.

The expansive outdoor terraces take full advantage of the Riviera Maya’s tropical climate. They feature a pool and a generously sized living and dining area, all perfect for al fresco gatherings or simply unwinding to the sound of the waves. The direct elevator access enhances privacy and convenience, while high-end finishes throughout the home add an extra layer of sophistication to this remarkable property.

Residents of Costa Residences enjoy access to the exclusive Costa Beach Club, a sprawling 10-acre luxury beachfront retreat designed to provide an unparalleled living experience. This private club boasts a variety of world-class amenities, including a spa, multiple pools, gourmet dining, a fitness center, a kids’ club, and a members-only beachfront Owners Club. Beyond the club, Corasol offers an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Nick Price, scenic nature trails, cenote parks, and an array of fine dining and shopping experiences, ensuring that every need is met within this elite community.

Ideally situated just minutes from Playa del Carmen and a short drive from Tulum and Cancun International Airport, this six-bedroom beachfront condo is perfectly positioned for those seeking a luxurious yet tranquil escape in the heart of the Mexican Caribbean. With its unrivaled ocean views, sophisticated design, and exclusive access to Riviera Maya’s most coveted resort amenities, this exceptional residence presents a rare opportunity to own a piece of paradise.

          " Set within the prestigious Costa Residences & Beach Club, this extraordinary six-bedroom beachfront condo redefines luxury living in the heart of the Riviera Maya. Located inside Corasol, the region's most sought-after private gated community, this stunning residence offers a seamless blend of modern sophistication, coastal serenity, and exclusive resort-style amenities just steps from the soft white sands of the Caribbean Sea.



Designed by the renowned CUAIK Arquitectos, this two-level Pentgarden residence is a true architectural masterpiece. It offers an expansive 4811 square feet (447 square meters) of elegantly appointed interior space, complemented by 4445 square feet (413 square meters) of stunning outdoor terraces, creating an impressive total of 9256 square feet (860 square meters) of seamless indoor-outdoor living. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame breathtaking ocean views, while the open-concept design invites natural light to flow throughout, enhancing the sense of space and connection to the tropical surroundings.



Every detail of this luxurious beachfront home has been carefully curated to provide an elevated lifestyle. The chef's kitchen is outfitted with high-end appliances, custom cabinetry, and sleek countertops, making it an ideal space for everyday living and entertaining. The primary suite is a private retreat with its own ocean-view terrace and a spa-like ensuite bath designed for ultimate relaxation. Additional bedrooms offer equally impressive finishes, spacious layouts, and private bathrooms, ensuring that every resident and guest enjoys the pinnacle of comfort.



The expansive outdoor terraces take full advantage of the Riviera Maya's tropical climate. They feature a pool and a generously sized living and dining area, all perfect for al fresco gatherings or simply unwinding to the sound of the waves. The direct elevator access enhances privacy and convenience, while high-end finishes throughout the home add an extra layer of sophistication to this remarkable property.



Residents of Costa Residences enjoy access to the exclusive Costa Beach Club, a sprawling 10-acre luxury beachfront retreat designed to provide an unparalleled living experience. This private club boasts a variety of world-class amenities, including a spa, multiple pools, gourmet dining, a fitness center, a kids' club, and a members-only beachfront Owners Club. Beyond the club, Corasol offers an 18-hole championship golf course designed by Nick Price, scenic nature trails, cenote parks, and an array of fine dining and shopping experiences, ensuring that every need is met within this elite community.



Ideally situated just minutes from Playa del Carmen and a short drive from Tulum and Cancun International Airport, this six-bedroom beachfront condo is perfectly positioned for those seeking a luxurious yet tranquil escape in the heart of the Mexican Caribbean. Expert Insights on Living and Investing in Tulum Hotel Zone, Tulum
------------------------------------------------------------------

Local advisor perspectives on what it is like to live and invest in this sought-after neighborhood.

![Elizabeth Gregg](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Eli-Gregg.jpg)

Elizabeth Gregg•Luxury Broker

> After nearly 23 years living in the Mexican Caribbean and raising my family here, I still remember the early days when we spent many weekends along the Tulum coastline. At that time, the area was simple and very natural, with small beachfront hotels and very little development. It was just the ocean, the jungle, and a quiet stretch of Caribbean shoreline. I feel fortunate to have experienced Tulum during that time.
> 
> Over the years, both my family and the region have grown. Today the Tulum hotel zone has developed into one of the most unique destinations in the Mexican Caribbean. Ancient Mayan ruins, cenotes, jungle landscapes, international cuisine, and creative design all come together in one place.
> 
> What continues to draw people to Tulum is the experience itself. The beaches are known for their white sand and turquoise water, and the atmosphere combines nature, culture, food, and wellness in a way that few destinations can match.
> 
> Even after decades here, standing on the shoreline and looking out across the Caribbean still reminds me why this place became so special to so many people.

Expert Insights on Living and Investing in Region 15, Tulum
-----------------------------------------------------------

Local advisor perspectives on what it is like to live and invest in this sought-after neighborhood.

![Maxime Bertron](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/HeadShots-final-7-copy.jpg)

Maxime Bertron•Real Estate Agent

> Region 15 is the part of Tulum that still feels like the actual jungle, the essence of what most people come here looking for. I love how you can be driving through pure greenery, thinking, “Where on earth are we going?”, and then, suddenly, like a mushroom appearing out of nowhere, a beautiful project rises from the trees. Developers here usually keep at least 30% of the area green, and the quality of construction is impressive, especially in boutique projects. It’s also the fastest-growing area of Tulum right now.
> 
> Some of my favorite spots are inside Region 15, like Bodhi Tulum, one of the most conscious and eco-friendly developments in the area. Rubi Hotel is another place I love with a fantastic restaurant, a great cocktail bar, and a perfect day-pass spot to relax. Right nearby, you’ll find the Tulum Paddle Social Club tucked into the jungle and, next door, Los Morros, which has some of the best seafood in Tulum.
> 
> Life here feels peaceful and close to nature. Most owners and guests are foreigners seeking short-term rentals, and the real estate market is a mix of high-end eco-luxury condos, boutique projects, and an increasing number of Tulum-style villas.

#### Property Description

Set along one of the most sought after stretches of beachfront in the Tulum Hotel Zone, this exceptional villa offers a rare combination of privacy, natural beauty and timeless coastal living. Casa Chic is a place that welcomes you with warmth from the moment you arrive. It is a home that invites connection, celebration and the kind of memories that linger long after your stay.

With more than 80 feet of pristine white sand and turquoise water at its doorstep, the main residence provides generous space for relaxation and entertaining. The home features five bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, expansive indoor and outdoor living areas, and a spacious beachfront pool that becomes the centerpiece of daily life.

A separate two bedroom guest villa offers additional comfort and privacy for family or visitors. Together, the residences create a private retreat surrounded by soft ocean breezes, tropical greenery and the quiet charm that once defined early Tulum.

While the atmosphere feels peaceful and secluded, the villa remains close to the renowned dining, boutique wellness spots and vibrant nightlife that make this coastline so celebrated. Scorpios Hotel and Beach Club, Gitano Beach, Nomade and Casa Malca are all within walking distance, giving residents easy access to some of the most iconic destinations on the Tulum shoreline. The combination of tranquility and proximity creates an exceptional setting.

The property also sits only 100 meters from the entrance to the Sian Ka’an Biosphere Reserve, one of the most important protected natural areas in the region. This UNESCO designated sanctuary is known for its untouched coastline, wildlife, lagoons and rich ecological diversity, adding a rare environmental privilege to the villa’s location.

Beyond its lifestyle appeal, the estate presents extraordinary potential for future growth. New local regulations now allow the villa to add another level, and the large open frontage toward the road provides significant room for expansion. With its footprint, scale and standout location, the estate is well positioned for commercial possibilities, including the creation of a boutique hotel concept that aligns with the character of the Tulum coastline.

Casa Chic is more than a beachfront residence. It is a sanctuary shaped by nature, light and the rhythm of the sea. For those seeking not only a remarkable home but a legacy that can evolve with vision and intention, this is a rare opportunity to own one of the few true beachfront estates in the Tulum Hotel Zone.

          "Explore Casa Chic, a 7 bedroom luxury beachfront villa for sale in the Tulum Hotel Zone with a guest house, pool, direct beach access and exceptional expansion potential.",
          " Set along one of the most sought after stretches of beachfront in the Tulum Hotel Zone, this exceptional villa offers a rare combination of privacy, natural beauty and timeless coastal living. Casa Chic is a place that welcomes you with warmth from the moment you arrive. It is a home that invites connection, celebration and the kind of memories that linger long after your stay.



With more than 80 feet of pristine white sand and turquoise water at its doorstep, the main residence provides generous space for relaxation and entertaining. The home features five bedrooms with ensuite bathrooms, expansive indoor and outdoor living areas, and a spacious beachfront pool that becomes the centerpiece of daily life.



A separate two bedroom guest villa offers additional comfort and privacy for family or visitors. Together, the residences create a private retreat surrounded by soft ocean breezes, tropical greenery and the quiet charm that once defined early Tulum.



While the atmosphere feels peaceful and secluded, the villa remains close to the renowned dining, boutique wellness spots and vibrant nightlife that make this coastline so celebrated. Scorpios Hotel and Beach Club, Gitano Beach, Nomade and Casa Malca are all within walking distance, giving residents easy access to some of the most iconic destinations on the Tulum shoreline. The combination of tranquility and proximity creates an exceptional setting.



The property also sits only 100 meters from the entrance to the Sian Ka’an Biosphere Reserve, one of the most important protected natural areas in the region. This UNESCO designated sanctuary is known for its untouched coastline, wildlife, lagoons and rich ecological diversity, adding a rare environmental privilege to the villa’s location.



Beyond its lifestyle appeal, the estate presents extraordinary potential for future growth. New local regulations now allow the villa to add another level, and the large open frontage toward the road provides significant room for expansion. With its footprint, scale and standout location, the estate is well positioned for commercial possibilities, including the creation of a boutique hotel concept that aligns with the character of the Tulum coastline.



Casa Chic is more than a beachfront residence. It is a sanctuary shaped by nature, light and the rhythm of the sea. For those seeking not only a remarkable home but a legacy that can evolve with vision and intention, this is a rare opportunity to own one of the few true beachfront estates in the Tulum Hotel Zone."

#### Property Description

Unlock a high-performing asset and a coastal sanctuary with this exceptional opportunity: a sophisticated 3-bedroom (+1) residence **currently generating a 8% NET ROI from rentals**. Located within one of Playa del Carmen’s most prestigious master-planned beachfront communities, this home is designed for those who appreciate elegance, privacy, and resort-level amenities. This main-level residence offers a seamless blend of contemporary comfort, luxurious indoor–outdoor living, and proven financial performance.

#### An Expansive Private Terrace Designed for Indulgence

A highlight of this residence is its impressive 80-square-meter private terrace, thoughtfully designed as a personal sanctuary. Enjoy a generously sized plunge pool surrounded by loungers, shaded seating areas, and a hammock perfect for peaceful afternoons. Whether hosting guests al fresco or simply unwinding after a day in the sun, this expansive outdoor environment elevates everyday living into a resort-style experience.

#### Elegant Interiors Crafted for Comfort

Step inside to a beautifully appointed interior featuring refined design and a layout that prioritizes both comfort and privacy. The home includes:

*   A serene master suite with a king-size bed and spa-inspired ensuite
*   A spacious second bedroom with two full beds
*   A third bedroom with a queen bed and trundle, ideal for guests or family
*   An additional flexible room suitable for staff, storage, or a young child

Each main bedroom features its own ensuite bathroom, ensuring a boutique-hotel level of convenience. Tasteful furnishings, quality finishes, and meticulous upkeep make this residence move-in ready for the discerning buyer.

#### World-Class Amenities at Your Doorstep

Residents of this elite community enjoy unparalleled access to a curated collection of luxury amenities, including:

*   One of the largest resort-style pools in the Riviera Maya
*   A fully equipped fitness center
*   Tennis and pickleball courts
*   A tranquil spa offering massages and aesthetic treatments
*   On-site dining with beachfront and poolside service
*   A pristine white-sand beach reserved exclusively for residents, complete with attentive staff

The beachfront experience is notably serene, offering calm waters perfect for swimming, paddleboarding, and kitesurfing, all without the crowds of downtown beaches.

#### A Coveted Location Near Playa del Carmen’s Finest Attractions

Ideally situated just minutes from the acclaimed Quinta Avenida, the residence offers effortless access to fine dining, boutique shopping, art galleries, nightlife, and cultural landmarks. Here, you can enjoy the energy of Playa del Carmen while retreating to the tranquility and privacy of an exclusive coastal enclave.

#### Luxury Living With Impressive Investment Performance

Beyond its appeal as a private retreat, this residence has demonstrated excellent rental returns. Its combination of location, design, and amenities makes it highly sought-after by travelers seeking elevated accommodations, providing owners with the option to generate significant passive income.

#### Seamless Ownership With Professional Management

A dedicated on-site management team ensures a refined ownership experience, offering concierge services, pre-arrival preparations, cleaning, and assistance throughout your stay—catering to both homeowners and guests at a luxury standard.

If you are seeking a vacation home or a strategic investment property, Jerry Aguero is here to turn your vision into a reality.

### [Playa Centro](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/area/playa-centro/)
, [Playa del Carmen](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/playa-del-carmen/)

> Playa Centro is one of those places you understand better when you walk it. Everything feels close. Fifth Avenue runs through the whole area with cafés, restaurants, bars, rooftops, and beach clubs in every direction. And the best part is that every street leads to the beach, which makes daily life feel relaxed and easy.
> 
> Calle 38 is one of my favorite spots. It’s the greenest street in Playa, and it takes you straight to Playa 38, where you can walk along the shore toward Mamitas or Coco Beach. You’ll also find Taquería Sánchez there, easily some of the best tacos in town. For breakfast, I like Cachito, and if you want to eat right by the ocean, Piaggia is always a great choice.
> 
> What I love about this area is how easily people imagine their future here. Some picture slow mornings by the ocean, others see a winter escape, and others want a spot to enjoy their vacations while being in one of the region's best-performing Airbnb markets. And something I notice often is that they end up coming back more and more, escaping here whenever they can because they finally have their own piece of paradise.

### [Puerto Morelos](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/puerto-morelos/)

> Puerto Morelos is a small Mexican beach town, only about 20 minutes from Cancún and Playa del Carmen. The moment you get there, the rhythm changes. Life feels calmer, lighter, and a lot more present. It started as a fishing village, and even though it’s grown, it still keeps that easy coastal vibe where people know each other, and things move at their own pace.
> 
> The beach here is beautiful. The water is so calm it feels like a giant pool, and right in front of town, you have an incredible coral reef that’s amazing for snorkeling and diving. There’s also a strong local community, with small cafés and family-run restaurants that give the town a warm, laid-back feel. My favorite seafood place in the area is El Merkadito.
> 
> What I like about Puerto Morelos is how it’s growing while staying true to itself. New projects keep coming, but the mangrove areas remain protected, so you get ocean views on one side, green views on the other, and a lifestyle that’s simple, peaceful, and very easy to enjoy.

### [Isla Mujeres](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/isla-mujeres/)

> Isla Mujeres is one of the most desirable island destinations in the Mexican Caribbean, known for its clear turquoise water, relaxed atmosphere, and some of the most beautiful beaches in the region. Playa Norte is widely recognized as one of the top beaches in the Caribbean, with shallow crystal clear water and soft white sand that attracts visitors and residents year round.
> 
> Life on the island centers around the ocean. Snorkeling, sailing, beach clubs, and sunset views are part of daily life here. The food scene is also part of the experience, with everything from casual waterfront spots like La Palapa del Capitan to lively local favorites like The Joint Reggae Bar & Grill, along with unique dining experiences such as Samura Isla Mujeres.
> 
> From a real estate perspective, opportunities are limited because of the island’s small size, which has helped maintain strong long term value. Properties generally start around $350,000 to $400,000 USD for smaller homes or condos with partial ocean views, while luxury beachfront villas and residences can exceed $2 million USD.
> 
> Located about 30 minutes by ferry from Cancún and its international airport, Isla Mujeres offers a true island lifestyle while still providing convenient access to the mainland.

#### Property Description

Casa Luna is a masterpiece of contemporary architecture, an exceptional private estate crafted for those who expect nothing less than uncompromising luxury, refined design, and flawless livability. Defined by sculptural lines, expansive volumes, and an impressive collection of curated amenities, this residence embodies the essence of modern sophistication in Tulum. Every detail has been carefully considered, resulting in a home that feels both artfully designed and effortlessly livable.

#### Architectural Precision & Elevated Design

Casa Luna’s architectural language blends bold geometry with graceful flow, creating an atmosphere of serenity and visual harmony. Dramatic ceiling heights, full-height glass walls, and perfectly balanced proportions allow natural light to cascade throughout the interiors, enhancing the home’s clean, modern aesthetic. Premium materials and refined finishes support a timeless, gallery-like ambiance—an ideal backdrop for both intimate living and elevated entertaining. The thoughtful layout prioritizes functionality without sacrificing elegance, offering a modern sanctuary that feels expansive, intuitive, and beautifully composed.

#### Luxurious Interiors & Bespoke Finishes

Inside, Casa Luna unveils a sophisticated blend of stone, rich woods, custom millwork, and designer fixtures, each element selected to evoke understated luxury. The main living and dining pavilion opens seamlessly to the garden through oversized sliding glass doors, blurring the boundary between indoors and outdoors. At the heart of the home, a state-of-the-art gourmet kitchen pairs sculptural design with professional performance, complete with bespoke cabinetry, premium appliances, and generous workspaces suited to both casual daily living and exceptional hosting. Every interior space reflects an unrelenting commitment to comfort, quality, and elevated design.

#### Private Retreats with Seamless Comfort

Each bedroom suite is conceived as a tranquil sanctuary, offering generous layouts, spa-inspired en-suite bathrooms, custom storage, and serene views across gardens or private terraces. Advanced home technology, including intelligent lighting, zoned climate control, high-speed connectivity, and an integrated security system, ensures that daily living is as effortless as it is luxurious. Whether envisioned as a full-time residence or a high-performing luxury rental, Casa Luna is designed to deliver a flawless, turn-key lifestyle.

#### Resort-Style Outdoor Living

The estate’s outdoor environment is a private retreat unto itself, offering an atmosphere reminiscent of an exclusive boutique resort. Centered around a spectacular swimming pool, the garden features a swim-up bar, an integrated jacuzzi, and a captivating architectural waterfall that elevates both ambiance and design. Multiple sun terraces, shaded lounge areas, and outdoor dining zones create a variety of environments for relaxation, entertainment, and refined alfresco living. Clear sightlines and lush tropical landscaping capture the essence of Tulum’s natural beauty, while preserving a sense of expansiveness and privacy.

#### Extraordinary Amenities for a Complete Lifestyle

Casa Luna distinguishes itself with an amenity collection rarely found in a private residence. The entertainment basement is a showpiece: a fully realized nightlife-inspired environment featuring a luxury bar, multiple lounge zones, an LED dance floor, a DJ booth, and a pool table, an immersive setting designed for unforgettable evenings. For recreation, a dedicated golf simulator room offers a unique, sophisticated leisure experience.

The estate also includes dedicated wellness and productivity spaces. A private office ensures comfort and discretion for remote work, while a panoramic yoga deck perched above the treetops invites sunrise meditation and tranquil movement. Completing the wellness suite, a fully equipped gym, cold plunge, and sauna allow residents to enjoy a holistic fitness and recovery routine, without ever leaving home.

#### Location & Lifestyle

Situated within a secure gated community in Tulum’s prestigious Region 15, Casa Luna offers the ideal balance of privacy, modern architecture, and proximity to the region’s most desirable destinations. Surrounded by nature yet minutes from the beach, acclaimed restaurants, boutiques, and vibrant cultural attractions, the residence offers an effortless connection to everything that defines the Tulum lifestyle. The gated setting enhances peace of mind, while the neighborhood’s rising prominence contributes to exceptional long-term value.

          " Casa Luna is a masterpiece of contemporary architecture, an exceptional private estate crafted for those who expect nothing less than uncompromising luxury, refined design, and flawless livability. Defined by sculptural lines, expansive volumes, and an impressive collection of curated amenities, this residence embodies the essence of modern sophistication in Tulum. Every detail has been carefully considered, resulting in a home that feels both artfully designed and effortlessly livable.



Architectural Precision & Elevated Design



Casa Luna’s architectural language blends bold geometry with graceful flow, creating an atmosphere of serenity and visual harmony. Dramatic ceiling heights, full-height glass walls, and perfectly balanced proportions allow natural light to cascade throughout the interiors, enhancing the home’s clean, modern aesthetic. Premium materials and refined finishes support a timeless, gallery-like ambiance—an ideal backdrop for both intimate living and elevated entertaining. The thoughtful layout prioritizes functionality without sacrificing elegance, offering a modern sanctuary that feels expansive, intuitive, and beautifully composed.



Luxurious Interiors & Bespoke Finishes



Inside, Casa Luna unveils a sophisticated blend of stone, rich woods, custom millwork, and designer fixtures, each element selected to evoke understated luxury. The main living and dining pavilion opens seamlessly to the garden through oversized sliding glass doors, blurring the boundary between indoors and outdoors. At the heart of the home, a state-of-the-art gourmet kitchen pairs sculptural design with professional performance, complete with bespoke cabinetry, premium appliances, and generous workspaces suited to both casual daily living and exceptional hosting. Every interior space reflects an unrelenting commitment to comfort, quality, and elevated design.



Private Retreats with Seamless Comfort



Each bedroom suite is conceived as a tranquil sanctuary, offering generous layouts, spa-inspired en-suite bathrooms, custom storage, and serene views across gardens or private terraces. Advanced home technology, including intelligent lighting, zoned climate control, high-speed connectivity, and an integrated security system, ensures that daily living is as effortless as it is luxurious. Whether envisioned as a full-time residence or a high-performing luxury rental, Casa Luna is designed to deliver a flawless, turn-key lifestyle.



Resort-Style Outdoor Living



The estate’s outdoor environment is a private retreat unto itself, offering an atmosphere reminiscent of an exclusive boutique resort. Centered around a spectacular swimming pool, the garden features a swim-up bar, an integrated jacuzzi, and a captivating architectural waterfall that elevates both ambiance and design. Multiple sun terraces, shaded lounge areas, and outdoor dining zones create a variety of environments for relaxation, entertainment, and refined alfresco living. Clear sightlines and lush tropical landscaping capture the essence of Tulum’s natural beauty, while preserving a sense of expansiveness and privacy.



Extraordinary Amenities for a Complete Lifestyle



Casa Luna distinguishes itself with an amenity collection rarely found in a private residence. The entertainment basement is a showpiece: a fully realized nightlife-inspired environment featuring a luxury bar, multiple lounge zones, an LED dance floor, a DJ booth, and a pool table, an immersive setting designed for unforgettable evenings. For recreation, a dedicated golf simulator room offers a unique, sophisticated leisure experience.



The estate also includes dedicated wellness and productivity spaces. A private office ensures comfort and discretion for remote work, while a panoramic yoga deck perched above the treetops invites sunrise meditation and tranquil movement. Completing the wellness suite, a fully equipped gym, cold plunge, and sauna allow residents to enjoy a holistic fitness and recovery routine, without ever leaving home.



Location & Lifestyle



Situated within a secure gated community in Tulum’s prestigious Region 15, Casa Luna offers the ideal balance of privacy, modern architecture, and proximity to the region’s most desirable destinations. Surrounded by nature yet minutes from the beach, acclaimed restaurants, boutiques, and vibrant cultural attractions, the residence offers an effortless connection to everything that defines the Tulum lifestyle. The gated setting enhances peace of mind, while the neighborhood’s rising prominence contributes to exceptional long-term value."

#### Property Description

Perched along the serene shoreline of Puerto Aventuras, Casa Caleta redefines coastal sophistication. Designed by acclaimed architect Alejandro Escudero, the creative force behind _NIZUC Resort & Spa_, this residence embodies a perfect balance between contemporary architecture and the timeless beauty of the Caribbean Sea.

#### Architecture as Art

Every line, texture, and finish of Casa Caleta has been crafted to evoke calm and connection. The 900 m² (9,688 ft²) residence unfolds across open, light-filled spaces where natural stone, hand-finished marble, and tropical hardwoods form a seamless dialogue with the ocean beyond. Escudero’s signature tropical minimalism celebrates authenticity—each element chosen not for ornamentation, but for harmony.

#### Refined Living, Inspired by Nature

Floor-to-ceiling glass doors dissolve boundaries between interior and exterior, revealing panoramic sea views from every room. The main living and dining pavilion opens to a private bay of turquoise water, while gentle breezes flow through shaded terraces and lush gardens. Each of the six bedroom suites offers a sanctuary of privacy and design, complemented by spa-inspired bathrooms and terraces framed by the sea.

#### A Sanctuary for the Senses

Outdoors, a resort-style infinity pool and Jacuzzi merge with the horizon, while the rooftop terrace features a bar, lounge, and fire pit—a setting where sunsets feel endless. The atmosphere is one of understated opulence: elegant yet effortless, sophisticated yet deeply connected to nature.

#### Crafted for the Discerning Few

Offered fully furnished and turnkey, Casa Caleta is curated with bespoke furnishings and hand-selected décor that reflect artistry and restraint. A bonus suite or private gym, staff quarters, four parking spaces, and a fully equipped chef’s kitchen complete the home’s rare combination of luxury and livability.

#### The Essence of Puerto Aventuras Living

Nestled within a secure, gated enclave, residents enjoy access to a world-class marina, golf course, fine dining, and boutique shopping—all within a community defined by peace and exclusivity. Beyond its beauty, Casa Caleta offers versatility: equally ideal as a private oceanfront residence, luxury retreat, or boutique hospitality concept for the world’s most refined travelers.

#### The Art of Living Well

Casa Caleta is not merely a home—it is an experience of presence and perfection, where architecture, craftsmanship, and the sea become one. For those who seek a legacy property along Mexico’s most coveted coastline, Casa Caleta stands as a rare expression of contemporary elegance and coastal grace.

### [Playa del Carmen](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/playa-del-carmen/)

> Playa del Carmen isn’t just a tropical getaway, it’s one of the most well-rounded places to live and invest on the Caribbean coast. What makes Playa special is how effortlessly lifestyle and convenience overlap. You can walk from your condo to the beach, grab dinner on Fifth Avenue, meet friends at a rooftop pool, or take a ferry to Cozumel for the day. It’s relaxed, but there’s always something happening.
> 
> From an investment standpoint, Playa has been remarkably consistent. Tourism continues to grow, the city continues to expand in innovative ways, and demand for vacation rentals remains strong year-round. Buyers appreciate that they’re getting both long-term value and a place they can personally enjoy.
> 
> What I like most about Playa is the balance it offers: urban energy, great dining, beautiful beaches, and a welcoming community. Whether you’re considering a second home, a rental property, or a full-time move, Playa del Carmen delivers a lifestyle that’s hard to beat.

### [Tulum](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/tulum/)

> Tulum has a distinct energy that sets it apart from every other coastal destination in Mexico. What always strikes me is the balance between natural beauty and a genuinely elevated lifestyle. You’ve got white-sand beaches, warm turquoise water, and miles of untouched jungle, but also world-class dining, wellness retreats, boutique hotels, and thoughtfully designed residential communities.
> 
> What I appreciate most about Tulum is how easy it is to slow down here. Mornings often start with a bike ride or a beachfront espresso; afternoons flow into time at a beach club or exploring a cenote; and evenings feel almost magical, with candlelit restaurants and open-air lounges.
> 
> From a real estate perspective, Tulum continues to attract buyers who value design, privacy, and a strong connection to nature. Whether someone is investing, relocating, or looking for a second home, Tulum offers a lifestyle that feels modern, intentional, and genuinely inspiring.

### [Puerto Aventuras](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/puerto-aventuras/)

> Puerto Aventuras is one of those rare places where everything you need is right at your fingertips. It’s a gated marina community with a calm, friendly atmosphere, but it still has all the amenities of a true resort town. You’ve got the main marina lined with cafés and shops, the beachfront hotel zone, Phase 4 with its newer luxury homes, and the golf course area that attracts full-time residents who love peaceful, walkable living.
> 
> What stands out most for me is the lifestyle. You can head out on your boat in the morning, play a round of golf in the afternoon, and finish the day with dinner at Latitude 20, one of the community’s most popular spots for great food and live music.
> 
> Real estate here has strong long-term appeal thanks to its security, family-friendly environment, and marina-focused design. For many of our clients, Puerto Aventuras feels like the perfect balance between privacy, comfort, and Caribbean living.

### [Huatulco](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/huatulco/)

> Huatulco is one of the most unique coastal destinations in Mexico. Located on the Pacific coast of Oaxaca, the area is known for its natural beauty, relaxed atmosphere, and strong focus on environmental preservation. The region includes nine bays and more than 30 beaches spread across roughly 35 kilometers of coastline, many of them still quiet and surrounded by jungle landscapes.
> 
> Life here revolves around the ocean and nature. Snorkeling, boating, and exploring hidden beaches are part of everyday life, and many of the bays are protected by coral reefs that attract marine life and keep the water clear. Unlike some of Mexico’s larger resort destinations, Huatulco has developed at a slower pace, which helps preserve its natural scenery and relaxed lifestyle.
> 
> From a real estate perspective, Huatulco continues to gain attention as buyers discover the region. What was once a quiet fishing area has gradually become one of the Pacific coast’s emerging property markets, attracting both international visitors and investors looking for a quieter alternative to more crowded destinations.
> 
> For buyers who value nature, ocean views, and a laid-back coastal lifestyle, Huatulco offers a very different experience from the busier parts of Mexico’s Caribbean coast.

### [San Miguel de Allende](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/san-miguel-de-allende/)

> San Miguel de Allende is one of Mexico’s most distinctive lifestyle destinations. Located in the central highlands of Guanajuato, the city is known for its colonial architecture, vibrant arts scene, and walkable historic center. The heart of the city is the UNESCO World Heritage historic district, where cobblestone streets, historic churches, and colorful buildings create one of the most recognizable townscapes in Mexico.
> 
> Life in San Miguel centers around culture and community. Residents enjoy art galleries, music festivals, farmers markets, rooftop restaurants, and a growing culinary scene that blends traditional Mexican flavors with international influences. The city also has a strong international community, which contributes to its dynamic cultural environment while maintaining deep local traditions.
> 
> From a real estate perspective, San Miguel de Allende has become one of the most established property markets in Mexico. Demand remains strong because of the city’s architecture, climate, cultural offerings, and reputation as one of the best small cities in the world to live and retire.
> 
> For buyers looking for a walkable city rich in history, culture, and lifestyle amenities, San Miguel de Allende offers a very different experience from Mexico’s coastal destinations while remaining one of the country’s most desirable places to own property.

### [Merida](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/merida/)

> Mérida has become one of the most compelling cities in Mexico for buyers who want more than just a property. It offers a lifestyle defined by culture, connectivity, long-term livability, and growing international attention.
> 
> What makes Mérida especially attractive is its balance. It is a city with deep historical character and a strong cultural identity, yet it continues to evolve in ways that matter to today’s buyer. The city is globally recognized by UNESCO as a Creative City of Gastronomy, and that distinction reflects something larger than its food scene. It speaks to the authenticity of the destination, the strength of local traditions, and the quality of life people feel when they spend time here.
> 
> From a real estate perspective, Mérida appeals to a wide range of buyers, including full-time residents, retirees, second-home owners, and investors looking for a market with substance. Buyers are drawn to its architectural beauty, established neighborhoods, strong sense of community, and access to both city conveniences and the Yucatán coast. Mérida also benefits from increasing visibility tied to infrastructure, connectivity, and investment momentum across the state. The city highlighted these strengths at FITUR 2026, emphasizing infrastructure and connectivity as key advantages, while the broader Yucatán region continues to position itself as an attractive place for investment.
> 
> Accessibility is another major factor. Mérida’s airport continues to serve meaningful passenger traffic, reinforcing the city’s role as a key gateway for domestic and international movement in southeastern Mexico.
> 
> In my view, Mérida stands out because it does not rely on hype. It offers real lifestyle value, cultural depth, and lasting appeal. For buyers looking at Mexico with a long-term perspective, Mérida deserves serious attention.

#### About Me

Maxime Bertron specializes in residential real estate across some of the most sought-after areas in the Riviera Maya, including Akumal, Bacalar, Playa del Carmen, Puerto Aventuras, Puerto Morelos, and Tulum. Originally from Angers, France, Maxime brings an international perspective and a deep passion for the Mexican Caribbean to his work.

Maxime’s journey to Mexico began in 2016 during a university exchange program. Over the course of four months, he fell in love with the country—its vibrant culture, breathtaking landscapes, delicious cuisine, and welcoming people. Though he returned to France to complete his master’s degree, the dream of returning to Mexico stayed with him.

In 2019, Maxime made that dream a reality, moving to Tulum to embrace the Caribbean lifestyle and immerse himself in the region’s unparalleled natural beauty. Since then, he has called this paradise home and has dedicated himself to helping others find their perfect place in the Riviera Maya.

Whether you’re looking for a serene retreat in Bacalar, a luxury villa in Tulum, or a vibrant property in Playa del Carmen, Maxime’s expertise and commitment ensure an exceptional real estate experience. Let him guide you to your dream home and help you live your own Caribbean dream.

### [Region 15](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/area/region-15/)
, [Tulum](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/tulum/)

> Region 15 is the part of Tulum that still feels like the actual jungle, the essence of what most people come here looking for. I love how you can be driving through pure greenery, thinking, “Where on earth are we going?”, and then, suddenly, like a mushroom appearing out of nowhere, a beautiful project rises from the trees. Developers here usually keep at least 30% of the area green, and the quality of construction is impressive, especially in boutique projects. It’s also the fastest-growing area of Tulum right now.
> 
> Some of my favorite spots are inside Region 15, like Bodhi Tulum, one of the most conscious and eco-friendly developments in the area. Rubi Hotel is another place I love with a fantastic restaurant, a great cocktail bar, and a perfect day-pass spot to relax. Right nearby, you’ll find the Tulum Paddle Social Club tucked into the jungle and, next door, Los Morros, which has some of the best seafood in Tulum.
> 
> Life here feels peaceful and close to nature. Most owners and guests are foreigners seeking short-term rentals, and the real estate market is a mix of high-end eco-luxury condos, boutique projects, and an increasing number of Tulum-style villas.

### [Tulum Country Club](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/area/tulum-country-club/)
, [Tulum](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/tulum/)

> Tulum Country Club offers a secure, well-maintained environment that invites peace of mind, making it ideal for those seeking safety and tranquility in the Riviera Maya. I have a client who built a home there, and every time I visit, I’m struck by how immaculate everything looks: the greenery, the gardens, the trees. It honestly feels like living in a U.S. golf course community, but surrounded by the beauty of the Mexican Caribbean. The golf itself is superb, offering a PGA-level course, and the whole area has a calm, residential atmosphere.
> 
> One of the biggest highlights is Kay Beach Club, a private beachfront escape with excellent service, fantastic food, and a swimming pool overlooking the Ocean. Families appreciate having a well-known international school right in the community, making daily life even more convenient.
> 
> Suppose you are looking for a peaceful holiday or retirement home, prioritizing security and a lifestyle similar to what you experience back home. In that case, this is the place to feel at ease and truly enjoy your time in Tulum & the Riviera Maya.

### [Bacalar](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/bacalar/)

> Bacalar represents a rare shift in Quintana Roo real estate, offering a true pueblo atmosphere deeply connected to its lagoon and surrounding jungle. It is the primary destination in the Costa Maya for those seeking a slower pace of life without sacrificing future appreciation. While areas further north have moved toward high-density urban living, the market here is defined by strict low-density requirements and environmental regulations. Most new projects adhere to a limited coefficient of land occupation to leave the majority of the jungle canopy intact, ensuring long-term value for investors who prioritize privacy and sustainable growth.
> 
> We are currently in a strategic early-entry phase for the region. The arrival of the Tren Maya and the opening of the nearby Ichkabal archaeological site are transforming Bacalar from a hidden gem into a globally accessible destination. This is a long-term investment play focused on steady appreciation and land banking rather than high-turnover rentals. Life here revolves around the water, from the natural currents of Los Rapidos to the refined afternoons at La Playita.
> 
> To understand the local rhythm, a visit to the central park, Parque General Angel Remigio Rosado, for authentic marquesitas is essential. For a relaxed evening, I Scream Bar offers a fun local feel, while Habitas Bacalar leads the way in eco-conscious hospitality. Bacalar is the ideal choice for those looking to disconnect from the noise and secure a footprint in a destination where nature remains the primary luxury.

#### Property Description

Set on 45 hectares (111 acres) of pristine landscape in Bacalar, Quintana Roo, this private estate offers an exceptional opportunity to own a rare retreat in Mexico’s fastest-emerging luxury destination. The property features two independent villas—together providing 8 bedrooms, unmatched privacy, and versatile options for personal use or high-performing rental income.

#### Lagoon-View Villa

The first residence is a modern villa designed to showcase panoramic views of the famous Bacalar Lagoon. Floor-to-ceiling glass doors open to expansive terraces, creating seamless indoor–outdoor living. Highlights include a chef’s kitchen with premium finishes, a spa-inspired primary suite, and an infinity-edge pool overlooking the turquoise waters.

#### Jungle Retreat Villa

The second residence is a larger, contemporary villa immersed in the tropical jungle. With six bedrooms across multiple wings, this residence offers privacy for guests or extended family. Generous living and dining spaces, covered outdoor lounges, and a private pool make it ideal for gatherings or as a boutique rental property.

#### Estate Features

*   45 hectares (111 acres) of natural land with lush flora and pathways
*   Two fully independent luxury residences with 8 bedrooms total
*   Infinity-edge and private pools surrounded by nature
*   Rare opportunity for eco-luxury development or expansion
*   Exceptional blend of privacy, lifestyle, and investment potential

#### The Location: Bacalar

Known as the “Lagoon of Seven Colors,” Bacalar has become a premier destination for luxury living and eco-conscious investment. Its crystalline waters, boutique lifestyle, and growing global recognition position this estate as both a personal sanctuary and a strategic long-term investment.

#### Property Description

Tucked away in the lush jungle of Tulum, just minutes from the beach and the energy of downtown, Rae’s Tulum is a one-of-a-kind estate that balances refined elegance with the tranquility of nature. Designed for privacy, serenity, and connection, this seven-bedroom villa spans three thoughtfully crafted buildings and offers a rare combination of architectural beauty, intimate gathering spaces, and modern luxury amenities.

From the moment you enter through tropical gardens and hand-built archways, Rae’s feels curated and soulful. Rich textures, velvet accents, and artisan details frame every room. A 200-year-old grand piano sits at the heart of the home’s main salon, beside a custom-designed cocktail bar that opens to the outdoors. The layout is intentional—offering space to come together or retreat into stillness, surrounded by jungle views, sunlight, and gentle breeze.

#### Sophisticated Interiors and Architectural Harmony

The main house is home to the expansive primary suite, complete with a large private terrace, rooftop swimming pool, walk-in closet, marble-finished en-suite bath, and lounge area with panoramic views of the trees and sky. Two additional guest bedrooms are located on the ground floor, each with private terraces, garden views, and outdoor showers. The pool house offers two more king bedrooms with private lounges and direct access to the main pool area, while the spa house includes two upper-level suites with balconies, one designed as a tranquil children’s bunk room, the other connected by a spiral staircase to a king bedroom with its own en-suite.

Throughout the home, details like custom woodwork, natural stone finishes, and floor-to-ceiling glass reflect the balance between rustic textures and clean, contemporary lines.

#### Resort-Caliber Amenities in a Private Setting

Rae’s Tulum is more than a villa—it is a private retreat designed for elevated living and entertaining. Two swimming pools—one 18 meters long on the ground floor surrounded by sun loungers and a shaded cabaña with pizza oven and grill, and another on the rooftop—invite moments of leisure and luxury. The estate features an outdoor dining pavilion, a pickleball court, and a full spa room with a sauna for two, a cold plunge pool, and a massage table.

The indoor chef’s kitchen is fully equipped with high-end appliances, a wine fridge, an espresso machine, and curated culinary tools. A Smart TV, sound system, and Wi-Fi support modern comfort without disrupting the natural serenity of the space. Security cameras, street parking, and daily services ensure peace of mind for homeowners and guests alike.

#### **A Distinctive Investment or Personal Sanctuary**

Whether envisioned as a private family retreat, a boutique rental villa, or an investment property in Tulum’s thriving luxury market, Rae’s Tulum offers a unique blend of elegance, comfort, and sense of place. Located just outside the busiest areas, yet within easy access to beaches, cenotes, and fine dining, this property is ideal for those seeking privacy without isolation.

          " Tucked away in the lush jungle of Tulum, just minutes from the beach and the energy of downtown, Rae’s Tulum is a one-of-a-kind estate that balances refined elegance with the tranquility of nature. Designed for privacy, serenity, and connection, this seven-bedroom villa spans three thoughtfully crafted buildings and offers a rare combination of architectural beauty, intimate gathering spaces, and modern luxury amenities.



From the moment you enter through tropical gardens and hand-built archways, Rae’s feels curated and soulful. Rich textures, velvet accents, and artisan details frame every room. A 200-year-old grand piano sits at the heart of the home’s main salon, beside a custom-designed cocktail bar that opens to the outdoors. The layout is intentional—offering space to come together or retreat into stillness, surrounded by jungle views, sunlight, and gentle breeze.



Sophisticated Interiors and Architectural Harmony



The main house is home to the expansive primary suite, complete with a large private terrace, rooftop swimming pool, walk-in closet, marble-finished en-suite bath, and lounge area with panoramic views of the trees and sky. Two additional guest bedrooms are located on the ground floor, each with private terraces, garden views, and outdoor showers. The pool house offers two more king bedrooms with private lounges and direct access to the main pool area, while the spa house includes two upper-level suites with balconies, one designed as a tranquil children’s bunk room, the other connected by a spiral staircase to a king bedroom with its own en-suite.



Throughout the home, details like custom woodwork, natural stone finishes, and floor-to-ceiling glass reflect the balance between rustic textures and clean, contemporary lines.



Resort-Caliber Amenities in a Private Setting



Rae’s Tulum is more than a villa—it is a private retreat designed for elevated living and entertaining. Two swimming pools—one 18 meters long on the ground floor surrounded by sun loungers and a shaded cabaña with pizza oven and grill, and another on the rooftop—invite moments of leisure and luxury. The estate features an outdoor dining pavilion, a pickleball court, and a full spa room with a sauna for two, a cold plunge pool, and a massage table.



The indoor chef’s kitchen is fully equipped with high-end appliances, a wine fridge, an espresso machine, and curated culinary tools. A Smart TV, sound system, and Wi-Fi support modern comfort without disrupting the natural serenity of the space. Security cameras, street parking, and daily services ensure peace of mind for homeowners and guests alike.



A Distinctive Investment or Personal Sanctuary



Whether envisioned as a private family retreat, a boutique rental villa, or an investment property in Tulum’s thriving luxury market, Rae’s Tulum offers a unique blend of elegance, comfort, and sense of place. Located just outside the busiest areas, yet within easy access to beaches, cenotes, and fine dining, this property is ideal for those seeking privacy without isolation.

Nine bedrooms across four buildings

#### Property Description

Experience elevated coastal living in this exquisite oceanfront penthouse at Amanecer Coastal Casitas, perfectly positioned on Playa Arrocito in Huatulco. This turnkey 2-bedroom, 3-bathroom residence spans 2,035 ft² and is designed by acclaimed architect Jorge Herrera to blend sophisticated style with seamless functionality.

#### Sophisticated Interiors & Layout

*   **Open-Concept Living**: Expansive living and dining areas feature panoramic windows and sliding doors that flood the space with natural light, framing stunning Pacific Ocean views.
*   **Gourmet Kitchen**: Fully equipped with premium appliances, a built-in oven, microwave, and ample counter space for both casual meals and elegant entertaining.
*   **Elegant Suites**: Two spacious bedrooms, each with ensuite baths, ceiling fans, and floor-to-ceiling sliding doors, plus an additional guest powder room for convenience.

#### Private Rooftop Terrace & Views

Ascend to your private rooftop haven—an ideal spot for sunset cocktails, alfresco dining, or quiet mornings overlooking the shimmering Pacific. The terrace’s open layout invites seamless indoor-outdoor living, making it perfect for both relaxation and entertaining under the stars.

#### Resort-Style Amenities & Community Features

*   **Oceanfront Infinity Pool**: Lounge poolside or take a refreshing dip steps from the shore.
*   **Gated Security**: 24/7 surveillance ensures privacy and peace of mind.
*   **Lush Gardens & BBQ Areas**: Landscaped grounds with communal grill stations and shaded seating.
*   **Covered Parking**: Convenient access to every level of the community.

#### Ideal for Residence or Investment

Sold fully furnished and move-in ready, the Amanecer Penthouse is an exceptional Huatulco real estate opportunity—whether you seek a permanent coastal retreat, vacation escape, or high-end rental investment.

#### Property Description

This luxury boutique hotel presents a rare investment opportunity in the exclusive gated community of Residencial Conejos, located in Bahías de Huatulco, Oaxaca. Overlooking Playa Tejoncito and the Pacific Ocean, the property combines elegant design with turnkey functionality, just 10 minutes from downtown Crucecita and 20 minutes from Huatulco International Airport.

The hotel features nine spacious guest suites, each with a private terrace or balcony, as well as a separate maid’s suite and two additional half-baths for guests. Designed and furnished to Canadian hotelier standards, the property features a full commercial kitchen, fine dining restaurant with bar, infinity pools, and professionally landscaped gardens.

Guests enjoy premium amenities, including Starlink high-speed internet, air conditioning, Bluetooth speakers, in-room tablets, and locally sourced Oaxacan textiles and artwork. The hotel also offers exclusive access to a private beach club within the community.

#### Property Overview

*   Bedrooms: 9 guest suites plus service quarters
*   Bathrooms: 12 (including 2 half baths)
*   Construction: 10,500 sq. ft.
*   Lot Size: Includes undeveloped 10,120 sq. ft. lot for expansion
*   Community: Residencial Conejos with private beach club access
*   Location: 10 minutes to Crucecita, 20 minutes to Huatulco International Airport

Fully operational with experienced management in place, this boutique hotel is a proven revenue-generating asset in one of Mexico’s fastest-growing coastal markets. Ideal for investors seeking immediate returns and long-term value.

#### About Me

Born and raised in Thunder Bay, Ontario, Tony Rabachuk later made British Columbia his home before discovering his true passion for life along Mexico’s stunning Caribbean coast.

With a background spanning home renovations, contracting, and property maintenance in Canada, Tony developed a deep understanding of construction quality, design, and value expertise that seamlessly translated into his real estate career. Today, as a trusted Real Estate Advisor with Christie’s International Real Estate Mexico, Tony helps clients from around the world discover extraordinary homes and investment opportunities in one of the world’s most desirable destinations.

Tony takes pride in guiding clients through every step of the buying process, combining professionalism, local insight, and a genuine love for the Riviera Maya lifestyle. Whether assisting first-time buyers or seasoned investors, he is committed to helping each client find their perfect property and create the life they envision.

When he isn’t working with clients, Tony enjoys immersing himself in the region’s natural beauty—swimming in the Caribbean Sea, exploring the jungle, or spending time with friends and family. A lifelong musician and passionate restorer of vintage cars and homes, Tony approaches every project with creativity and dedication.

### [Cenote](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/features/cenote/)

> A cenote is a natural freshwater pool formed over thousands of years within the limestone terrain of the Yucatán Peninsula. Fed by the region’s vast underground river system, cenotes are one of the most distinctive natural features in southeastern Mexico and an important part of the Riviera Maya landscape. For the ancient Maya, these water sources held deep cultural and spiritual significance. Today, they continue to be valued for their natural beauty, environmental importance, and connection to the land.
> 
> From a real estate perspective, a property with its own cenote is exceptionally rare. In the Riviera Maya, this kind of feature offers a level of privacy, character, and setting that is difficult to replicate. Beyond visual appeal, it creates a true sense of place - something rooted in the geography and identity of this region. Whether used as a peaceful space for swimming, relaxation, or simply as a preserved natural focal point within the property, a cenote adds a distinctive lifestyle element that stands apart from more conventional amenities.
> 
> For buyers considering real estate in the Riviera Maya, a private cenote can also strengthen long-term appeal. Unique natural features often contribute to a property’s desirability, especially when they are integrated thoughtfully into the home and preserved with care. In a market where buyers increasingly value authenticity, privacy, and a meaningful connection to nature, a cenote can make a property feel truly one of a kind.

### [Punta Sur](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/area/punta-sur/)
, [Akumal](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/akumal/)

> Punta Sur is a small private beachfront community located between Akumal and Tulum, directly across from the Tulum Country Club. After years working in this market and selling several properties in the area, it remains one of my favorite locations along this stretch of coastline.
> 
> The community is located about the same distance from Cancun International Airport and Tulum International Airport, which makes travel convenient for owners and guests. It is also about 25 minutes north of the Tulum hotel zone and roughly 30 minutes south of Playa del Carmen Centro, placing it in a very central location.
> 
> One of Punta Sur’s biggest advantages is the ocean conditions. The coastal currents in this area tend to push sargassum away from the shoreline, so the beachfront often has clearer water and wide open Caribbean views.
> 
> The immediate shoreline is mostly rocky, which helps keep the water clear. However, sandy beaches are only minutes away. Aventuras Akumal beach is about a five minute walk to the north, while Akumal Sur’s sandy shoreline is about five minutes to the south along the Akumal walking trail.
> 
> Another major benefit is infrastructure. Punta Sur is one of the few beachfront communities in the region with municipal water service, which is a significant advantage for long term ownership.

### [Tulum Hotel Zone](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/area/tulum-hotel-zone/)
, [Tulum](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/tulum/)

> After nearly 23 years living in the Mexican Caribbean and raising my family here, I still remember the early days when we spent many weekends along the Tulum coastline. At that time, the area was simple and very natural, with small beachfront hotels and very little development. It was just the ocean, the jungle, and a quiet stretch of Caribbean shoreline. I feel fortunate to have experienced Tulum during that time.
> 
> Over the years, both my family and the region have grown. Today the Tulum hotel zone has developed into one of the most unique destinations in the Mexican Caribbean. Ancient Mayan ruins, cenotes, jungle landscapes, international cuisine, and creative design all come together in one place.
> 
> What continues to draw people to Tulum is the experience itself. The beaches are known for their white sand and turquoise water, and the atmosphere combines nature, culture, food, and wellness in a way that few destinations can match.
> 
> Even after decades here, standing on the shoreline and looking out across the Caribbean still reminds me why this place became so special to so many people.

#### Property Description

Set deep within the jungle between Akumal and Puerto Aventuras, and just a 10-minute drive from the white sands of Xpu-Ha Beach, this fully walled estate spans more than 12 acres (approximately 4.5 hectares) across nine contiguous lots. Designed for total privacy and long-term independence, the property combines resort-level amenities with meticulous architectural execution rarely found in the region.

The estate is currently developed across four of the nine lots, including the main residence, a semi-remodeled guest house, and an additional secured parcel with a four-meter perimeter wall. The remaining lots offer exceptional potential for future expansion, additional residences, or bespoke amenities.

#### Signature Features

*   Expansive cenote-fed swimming pool alongside a palapa-covered entertainment pavilion
*   Natural underground cave system leading to a hidden speakeasy-style lounge
*   Commercial-grade Life Fitness gym
*   Subterranean wine cellar with capacity for more than 800 bottles
*   Full-service spa with sauna, hair, and nail facilities
*   Private cinema room
*   Five curated bar areas throughout the estate, including dedicated tequila and whisky bars
*   More than $3 million USD invested in mature tropical landscaping
*   Outdoor commercial kitchen adjacent to the pool and wine cellar

#### Underground Cavern Experience

One of Rancho Paraiso Oasis’s most remarkable elements is its natural underground cavern, discreetly accessed from the garage and parking area. Surrounded by dramatic stalactites and stalagmites, a concealed tunnel leads to a speakeasy-inspired whisky bar, entered through a classic British telephone booth. This space offers a truly immersive, unforgettable setting for private gatherings.

#### Infrastructure and Autonomy

*   Solar energy farm complemented by two backup generators with up to 14 days of power autonomy.
*   Fiber optic internet with dedicated server rooms
*   Double-wide golf cart paths throughout the compound
*   Multiple garages for vehicles and carts
*   Extensive storage and utility rooms
*   High security perimeter wall enclosing the entire estate

#### Full Service Staffing and Security

Rancho Paraiso Oasis operates as a fully staffed, turn-key property, supported by:

*   An executive chef and a commercial kitchen
*   Dedicated housekeeping, maintenance, and landscaping teams
*   Twelve on-site security personnel providing 24-hour coverage

Whether envisioned as a private family sanctuary, a luxury rental compound, a boutique wellness retreat, or a high-end event venue, Rancho Paraiso Oasis offers a level of scale, privacy, and self-sufficiency that is increasingly difficult to replicate.

Inquire today to request additional details or arrange a private showing of Rancho Paraiso Oasis.

#### Property Description

Jade Bay 9 is a distinguished beachfront villa in Akumal, offering an exclusive blend of contemporary design and Caribbean elegance. This private residence spans 800 m² (8,608 ft²) on 820 m² (8,823 ft²) of oceanfront land, delivering a luxurious retreat in one of the Riviera Maya’s most sought-after locations.

Designed for comfort and sophistication, the home features seven spacious bedrooms and seven-and-a-half bathrooms, each carefully appointed to provide a boutique resort-style experience. Expansive living areas, a fully equipped gourmet kitchen, and a private service casita with an office ensure both convenience and privacy.

Outdoor spaces are designed for relaxation and entertainment, with a large infinity-edge pool, beachfront lounge areas, and multiple palapas offering shaded retreats. The villa also includes a gated entrance, 24-hour security, and lush gardens, creating a private sanctuary along the coastline.

The property is fully turnkey and equipped with modern utilities, including CFE electricity, CAPA water, high-speed fiber-optic internet, and an environmentally conscious wetlands sewage system.

Located just minutes from Tulum’s world-class dining, luxury spas, and yacht charters, Jade Bay 9 offers an exceptional lifestyle with direct access to the Caribbean Sea. This rare beachfront home is ideal for those seeking privacy, elegance, and exclusivity in the Mexican Caribbean.

#### Property Description

Set along one of the most coveted stretches of Tulum’s pristine coastline, this is a rare opportunity to acquire two adjacent beachfront parcels—each with existing, high-value construction and exceptional future potential. The offering includes a fully operational 21-room hotel and a luxurious 6-bedroom villa, positioned side-by-side and ready to be transformed into a flagship hospitality asset in the Riviera Maya.

#### A Dual-Parcel Asset with Turnkey Upside

Together, the properties span nearly 2,000 m² of prime beachfront land and more than 2,200 m² of existing construction. The hotel parcel is home to a 21-key accommodation structure, designed with solid concrete construction and ready for operational scaling. Next door, the villa parcel—equal in size—currently houses a private, high-end residence already integrated into the rental pool. This parcel offers a clear path to duplicate the hotel’s structure, effectively doubling capacity to 40+ rooms.

Both parcels benefit from a clean title, established utilities, and a beachfront zoning profile that supports further development, whether through expansion, rebranding, or repositioning into a wellness or boutique retreat concept.

#### Strategic Value Based on Land + Replacement Cost

This opportunity is priced based on the value of the land and the cost of high-quality construction—not on the current operational performance of the hotel. The hotel asset is estimated at $6M USD ($2.5M land + $4.5M construction), while the villa parcel is included in the overall $8.5M USD price, with the land alone easily justifying $2.5M. The existing hotel business infrastructure, systems, and staffing can be included at a marginal cost, offering a seamless transition for experienced operators or boutique brands.

#### Development-Ready with Proven Execution Path

The current owner and team have already executed one full development cycle and can replicate it efficiently. Architectural, permitting, and construction pathways are well established—eliminating delays and uncertainty for investors ready to build. The villa parcel’s dimensions and zoning support the development of a twin structure, creating an ideal canvas for expansion with minimal friction.

#### Investment Highlights

*   Location: Oceanfront in Tulum’s high-value beach zone
*   Size: ~2,000 m² land across two equal-sized lots
*   Build Area: ~2,200 m² across hotel and villa
*   Zoning: Beachfront hospitality
*   Current Use: 21-key hotel + 6-bedroom luxury villa
*   Construction Type: Solid concrete block (no renovation needed)
*   Expansion Opportunity: Mirror hotel design on the second parcel
*   Business Option: Hotel operations available for takeover (optional)

#### For the Visionary Buyer

This offering is ideally suited for boutique hotel groups, hospitality brands seeking a flagship Tulum presence, or private investors and family offices looking for a long-term hold with development upside. It combines the security of hard assets with the scalability of a proven business model in one of Mexico’s most competitive beachfront markets.
