#### About Me

With more than three decades of experience in both U.S. and international markets, Jane Ford brings a distinguished record of performance, coastal development expertise, and client-first service to Christie’s International Real Estate Mexico. She is known for her disciplined approach, informed guidance, and ability to navigate complex transactions across premier destinations.

What sets Jane apart is her longstanding personal connection to the Riviera Maya. She has been coming to the region since 1979, previously lived here from 2003 to 2010, and is now a permanent resident living in Puerto Aventuras. This long-term relationship with the area gives her a depth of local familiarity that extends well beyond market knowledge alone and allows her to guide clients with a perspective shaped by decades of firsthand experience.

Originally from Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, Jane earned a bachelor’s degree in biochemistry, a master’s degree in secondary education, and later became a certified paralegal specializing in environmental law. Her real estate career began during a visit to North Carolina’s Outer Banks, where a chance conversation with a developer led to her first role in oceanfront development. She quickly advanced, eventually establishing her own brokerage in North Carolina and earning recognition as a top-performing real estate professional.

Jane’s career later expanded internationally, including advising buyers and investors in Playa del Carmen who were seeking vacation properties, second homes, and lifestyle-driven investments. She also relocated to Grand Cayman, where she worked with leading global firms including Sotheby’s and Engel & Völkers, representing clients across high-end residential, oceanfront, and new-development segments.

Today, Jane is valued for her ability to combine strategic insight with discretion, clarity, and attentive service. She works closely with clients acquiring land, second homes, and investment properties, and her experience across multiple coastal markets uniquely positions her to serve international buyers seeking meaningful opportunities in Mexico’s most desirable destinations.

Outside of real estate, Jane is an accomplished equestrian and FEI show-jumping judge who has traveled extensively for international competitions. She is fluent in Hungarian and enjoys riding her horse, Akua, as well as scuba diving, paddleboarding, and spending time outdoors with her dog, Teddy. Jane is a licensed real estate broker in North Carolina, Hawaii, and Grand Cayman, and she was recognized as a top producer in _Hawaii Business Magazine_ in 2021, 2022, and 2023.

#### About Me

Nicolas Lauras is a real estate advisor with Christie’s Real Estate Mexico, bringing seven years of dedicated industry expertise to his specialization in exceptional residences and high-performing investment opportunities across the Riviera Maya.

Born in France and shaped by years of international travel, he brings a global perspective to every client relationship. After arriving in Cancún nearly two decades ago, he recognized not only the region’s lifestyle appeal but also its long-term investment strength. Having witnessed the market’s evolution firsthand, he guides clients with insight grounded in deep local knowledge and strategic vision.

He works with discerning buyers, sellers, and investors who seek more than just a property; those who value quality, prime locations, and durable returns. His approach is highly personalized and detail-driven, designed to deliver a smooth acquisition process while aligning each decision with both lifestyle goals and financial objectives.

As Nico says:  
_“I am not here to just sell real estate; I am here to help you secure a lifestyle asset with high potential.”_

Expert Insights
---------------

### [Marina Front](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/area/marina-front/)

> Marina-front living offers one of the most peaceful and connected lifestyles in the Mexican Caribbean. Having guided countless families through their relocation to the Riviera Maya, I frequently recommend exploring the marina communities of Puerto Aventuras and Puerto Cancún. Unlike traditional beachfront properties, these homes offer a uniquely refined connection to the water. The calm canals and thoughtfully designed waterfront neighborhoods create an atmosphere that is perfectly suited for everyday living and long-term comfort.
> 
> In these areas, the marina naturally becomes the heart of the community. When I tour spacious 3- and 4-bedroom residences or single-family homes here, clients instantly connect with the seamless indoor-outdoor layouts, expansive terraces, and the convenience of having a private dock right outside their door. It completely transforms daily life. Whether it is enjoying a quiet morning overlooking the water, walking to nearby cafés and boutique shops, or taking the boat out for an afternoon on the Caribbean, the experience is unmatched.
> 
> Because inventory in these highly walkable, secure neighborhoods is naturally limited, true marina-front properties remain incredibly sought-after for those seeking a permanent residence or a welcoming second home. They provide an incredible combination of boating access, privacy, and immediate proximity to world-class amenities, making them the perfect choice for anyone looking to truly integrate into the coastal lifestyle.

### [Aldea Zama](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/area/aldea-zama/)
, [Tulum](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/tulum/)

> Aldea Zama is one of the most established residential communities in Tulum and is often one of the first areas I introduce to buyers exploring the market. In my experience working with clients in the region, it offers a strong balance of lifestyle appeal, accessibility, and long-term investment potential.
> 
> Unlike many parts of Tulum that developed organically, Aldea Zama was designed as a master-planned community. Residents benefit from paved roads, underground electricity, fiber optic internet, bike paths, and preserved green areas. Certain sections, including Aldea Zama Premium and La Privada, are gated communities with 24-hour security.
> 
> Location is another key advantage. Aldea Zama sits between Tulum’s town center and the beach with convenient access via Avenida Cobá and Kukulcán Boulevard. This allows residents to reach the hotel zone, restaurants, and beach clubs within minutes while still enjoying a quieter residential setting surrounded by jungle.
> 
> Because of its infrastructure, location, and consistent buyer demand, Aldea Zama remains one of the most sought-after areas in the Tulum real estate market. The community offers a mix of condos, villas, and boutique developments designed with Tulum’s signature style of natural materials and indoor-outdoor living.
> 
> For buyers looking for a property that combines lifestyle value with long-term stability in Tulum, Aldea Zama is often one of the strongest communities to consider.

#### About Me

Amanda is the Administration and Finance Manager at Christies International Real Estate – The Mexico Collection, where she oversees the operations and financial management of the department. With a keen eye for detail and a deep commitment to excellence, she plays a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of the company’s internal processes.

Originally from Chicago, Illinois, Amanda moved to the beautiful Riviera Maya in 2005, drawn by the area’s vibrant culture and breathtaking landscapes. As a dedicated mother of two, she has built a fulfilling life in this dynamic region, balancing her professional responsibilities with her passion for family and community.

Amanda is deeply connected to the Riviera Maya and cherishes the opportunity to work in a place that holds both personal and professional significance. Her love for the area is evident in her daily work and interactions, and she remains committed to contributing to the local community through both her career and personal endeavors.

#### About Me

Jorge Barragan, Listing and Development Manager for Christie’s International Real Estate Mexico Luxury Properties, plays a vital role in ensuring the seamless management of property listings across the company’s various platforms. Born and raised in Chetumal, Quintana Roo, Jorge has called the vibrant Riviera Maya home since the age of 18.

Jorge’s responsibilities include meticulously maintaining accurate and up-to-date listing information across all company websites and guaranteeing clients and agents have access to the latest property details. Additionally, he provides crucial support to the agent team, ensuring they have the resources and assistance needed to deliver exceptional service.

Known affectionately as “Georgie,” Jorge brings energy and enthusiasm to his work, reflecting his zest for life and commitment to excellence. Beyond his professional endeavors, Jorge enjoys exploring the natural beauty of the Riviera Maya, from sunrise beach walks to jungle adventures, all while staying grounded by his strong family values.

Jorge’s dedication to precision and collaboration makes him an invaluable member of the team, ensuring that both clients and agents experience a smooth and successful real estate journey.

#### About Me

With over 15 years of experience in luxury hospitality, Ángeles brings an exceptional level of service and expertise to Christie’s International Real Estate Mexico. Her career includes roles with prestigious organizations such as Chelsea FC, where she supported players and their families during their relocation to London, and A1 GP Racing in England, where she worked in Public Relations.

Ángeles also spent 15 years at Pemex, overseeing corporate image management, coordinating international forums and conferences, and handling administration and finance for international clients.

In the Riviera Maya, Ángeles has managed 15 luxury properties, including the renowned Esencia Villas, specializing in luxury rentals, concierge services, and creating exclusive, personalized experiences for guests.

Ángeles is passionate about delivering exceptional service, anticipating client needs, and curating unforgettable moments. As our Concierge Specialist, she is dedicated to ensuring that every client experience with Christie’s International Real Estate Mexico is seamless, personalized, and truly extraordinary.

#### About Me

Marc Andrew, widely known as “The Mexpert,” now serves as a Brand Ambassador for the Riviera Maya, with a focus on promoting the exceptional lifestyle and opportunities that make this region one of the most sought-after destinations in Mexico. After more than a decade of living in Puerto Aventuras, Marc has become a trusted local voice—celebrated not just for his knowledge of the area, but for his passion in connecting people to the best of what the Riviera Maya has to offer.

Originally from Canada, Marc’s own experience as an expatriate gives him a personal understanding of the transition to life in Mexico. In his role as Brand Ambassador, he now focuses on curating authentic experiences, offering insider tips, and helping others discover the real essence of the region—whether it’s a local organic butcher, a trusted mechanic, or the perfect beach for fresh coconut water.

Known affectionately as the “Riviera Maya Ambassador,” Marc’s genuine enthusiasm and deep-rooted connections make him an invaluable guide to anyone exploring the area. His background in real estate has given him a strong foundation in service, integrity, and clear communication—all of which he brings to his ambassador role.

When he’s not out exploring with his camera or enjoying beach days with his family, Marc continues to share his love for the Riviera Maya through community engagement and storytelling. Whether you’re considering a move or simply want to experience the local lifestyle, Marc is your go-to source for insight, inspiration, and connection.

#### About Me

Born and raised in Italy, Anna’s journey as a global citizen began with a deep academic foundation in Oriental Studies and graduation from institutions in both Italy and the United States. Before making her mark on the Mexican Caribbean, she cultivated a sophisticated level of customer care while managing world-class travel destinations in the Maldives, Madagascar, and Japan. This international background granted her mastery of four languages and a unique ability to navigate the complexities of relocation and high-stakes hospitality.

After years of exploring the globe, Anna chose the Riviera Maya as her permanent home in 2012. Settling in the gated marina community of Puerto Aventuras, she transitioned her extensive service expertise into real estate in 2017. Her move was driven by a personal mission to raise the bar on professionalism and transparency in the international investor purchasing process, helping her clients avoid common pitfalls and secure their ideal property.

Anna offers an insider’s perspective on the rapid evolution of the southern Riviera Maya. Having witnessed Tulum’s transformation into a premier global destination, she has worked closely with the visionaries behind Aldea Zama, Luum Zama, and Aldea Premium. Her deep-rooted relationships with leading architects and developers give her clients unparalleled access to iconic properties from Puerto Aventuras to Akumal and Tulum.

Now a key member of the Christie’s Real Estate Mexico team, Anna is recognized for her perseverance and genuine zeal for the industry, which makes the process of buying property in Mexico both smooth and rewarding. She embodies the philosophy that passion is the key to excellence, and when she isn’t scouting the latest coastal luxury opportunities, she enjoys the quintessential Riviera Maya lifestyle—traveling, swimming, and enjoying the vibrant local community with her friends and family.

### [Akumal](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/city/akumal/)

> Akumal is one of the Riviera Maya's best-kept secrets. It’s a fishermen’s village that has not changed much over the years, keeping the charm and authenticity of a Mexican coastal town and a laid-back feel. The bay is famous for its sandy beaches, vibrant marine life, and turtle population. Grab a nice breakfast at Turtle Bay Café and Bakery, or sit on the beach at Lol Ha Restaurant, an excellent stop before starting your day. From here, you can easily go for a swim, snorkel, or hop on a boat and go diving.
> 
> Across from the beach, around the small center, some restaurants and souvenir shops display local handicrafts, jewels, and art, while La Cueva del Pescador awaits you for incredible seafood and shrimp stuffed avocados.
> 
> Half Moon Bay boasts calm waters and a peaceful retreat with stunning views of the turquoise Caribbean Sea. It’s a paradise for snorkeling enthusiasts who can decide to swim on the reef to enjoy the beautiful Yalku Lagoon and its mangrove setting.
> 
> After an active day, you can stop at La Buena Vida, a true Akumal legend with an unbeatable vibe, and sip a Margarita or enjoy a seafood menu with your feet in the sand. For a fancy dinner, check out La Lunita, an excellent beachfront restaurant, or go back to Lol Ha for live music and some tropical drinks. For a taste of local life, across the highway, Akumal town offers multiple taco stands and small local restaurants that are worth a try.
> 
> Akumal nightlife is very relaxed and intimate compared to its neighboring cities, but this is its perk: a breezy atmosphere, ocean views, and uncrowded bars. And if you like silence, take a walk on the beach, enjoy the starry sky, and during the Summer season, if you are lucky, you might even witness baby sea turtles hatching.

Privacy Policy
==============

**Last Updated: September 11th, 2025**

Welcome to https://christiesrealestatemexico.com (the “Site”). We understand that privacy online is important to users of our Site, especially when conducting business. This statement governs our privacy policies with respect to those users of the Site (“Visitors”) who visit without transacting business and Visitors who register to transact business on the Site and make use of the various services offered by  
Christie’s International Real Estate Mexico Luxury Properties (collectively, “Services”) (“Authorized Customers”).

1.  **Personally Identifiable Information**
    *   Refers to any information that identifies or can be used to identify, contact, or locate the person to whom such information pertains, including but not limited to: name, address, phone number, fax number, email address, financial profiles, social security number, and credit card information. It does not include anonymous information or demographic information not connected to an identified individual.
2.  **What Personally Identifiable Information is Collected?**
    *   We may collect basic user profile information from all Visitors. We also collect additional information from Authorized Customers such as name, email address, and phone number.
3.  **What Organizations are Collecting the Information?**
    *   In addition to our direct collection, third-party service vendors (such as credit card companies, clearinghouses, and banks) may collect this information to provide services such as credit, insurance, and escrow. We do not control their use of information but request disclosure of how they use it. Some vendors act only as intermediaries and do not retain the information.
4.  **How Does the Site Use Personally Identifiable Information?**
    *   We use this information to customize the Website, make service offerings, and fulfill buying or selling requests. We may contact Visitors and Authorized Customers about opportunities or in response to inquiries.
5.  **With Whom May the Information Be Shared?**
    *   Information about Authorized Customers may be shared with other Authorized Customers evaluating transactions. We may share aggregated demographic information with affiliates and vendors. Visitors and Authorized Customers may opt out of being contacted.
6.  **How is Personally Identifiable Information Stored?**
    *   Information is securely stored and accessible only as needed for purposes described in this policy. It is not accessible to unauthorized third parties.
7.  **Choices Available to Visitors**
    *   Visitors and Authorized Customers may opt out of receiving communications by following instructions in emails or contacting us at 📧 [contact@christiesrealestatemexico.com](mailto:contact@christiesrealestatemexico.com)
        .
8.  **Cookies**
    *   A cookie is a string of data stored on a visitor’s device. We use cookies to collect information. You may refuse cookies via your browser, but some features may not function properly.
9.  **Are Cookies Used on the Site?**
    *   Yes. Cookies help us understand visitor preferences and improve security. For example, inactive sessions may be automatically logged out. Visitors may block cookies but some functionality may be lost.
10.  **Cookies Used by Our Service Providers**
    *   Our service providers may use cookies, which may be stored on your device. Details are available on our cookies info page.
11.  **Use of Login Information**
    *   We use login information such as IP addresses, ISPs, browser types, version, and pages visited to analyze trends, administer the site, and track usage.
12.  **Access by Partners or Service Providers**
    *   We work with vendors and affiliates who may access information as needed to evaluate service eligibility. Their use is not covered by this policy.
13.  **How Does the Site Keep Information Secure?**
    *   Only qualified employees with secure access can view personal data. Sensitive information is protected by encryption. While we take reasonable measures, we cannot guarantee against errors, tampering, or breaches.
14.  **Correcting Inaccuracies**
    *   Visitors may request updates or corrections by emailing us at 📧 [contact@christiesrealestatemexico.com](mailto:contact@christiesrealestatemexico.com)
        .
15.  **Deleting or Deactivating Information**
    *   Visitors may request deletion of information, though some residual data may remain in backups. Deactivated data will not be sold or used moving forward.
16.  **Your Rights**
    *   You have rights under data protection law, including: access, rectification, erasure, restriction, objection, portability, complaint to an authority, and withdrawal of consent.
17.  **Children’s Privacy**
    *   We do not knowingly collect information from children under 18. If you believe your child has provided personal data, please contact us for removal.
18.  **Compliance With Laws**
    *   We may disclose information as required by law, court order, or law enforcement, or to protect the safety of Visitors and Authorized Customers.
19.  **Changes to Privacy Policy**
    *   We will notify Visitors of updates by posting them here. If changes affect previously restricted disclosures, we will contact affected individuals.
20.  **Links**
    *   Our Website may contain links to other sites. Please review their privacy policies, as they may differ from ours.
21.  **Contact Us**
    *   If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, please contact us at 📧 [contact@christiesrealestatemexico.com](mailto:contact@christiesrealestatemexico.com)

#### Property Description

Experience the ultimate in tropical living with this stunning 3-bedroom ground-floor condo in the renowned Faena District Tulum. Surrounded by lush jungle and infused with the spirit of Mayan heritage, this residence offers a seamless blend of contemporary design and natural harmony.

Designed by acclaimed architect Brandon Haw, this condo features warm wood accents, polished chukum plaster, and an earthy palette of ochre yellows and dusty pinks. Expansive living spaces flow effortlessly into private outdoor terraces, where forest greenery creates a serene retreat. Burnt sienna screens add privacy and elegance, while soft light fills the home with a tranquil ambiance.

This ground-floor unit offers direct access to beautifully landscaped gardens, making it perfect for families or those seeking a close connection to nature. The fully equipped kitchen, luxurious bathrooms with mosaic detailing and soaking tubs, and spacious bedrooms make this home as functional as it is beautiful.

Residents enjoy access to Faena District’s exceptional amenities, including a residence-only swimming pool, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and vibrant communal spaces. The Faena Ocean Club, art pavilion, and Tierra Santa Healing House further elevate the lifestyle with opportunities for wellness, art, and community engagement.

Step into a world where luxury meets nature and creativity flourishes. This is more than a home; it’s a gateway to the transformative lifestyle of Faena District Tulum.

#### Property Description

Nestled in the heart of Tulum’s lush jungle, this 2-bedroom penthouse offers a harmonious blend of luxury, nature, and artistry. Located within the prestigious Faena District, the property is a sanctuary of holistic living designed to elevate your lifestyle.

Crafted by renowned architect Brandon Haw, the penthouse boasts contemporary design elements inspired by ancient Mayan construction. Interiors feature polished chukum plaster, warm wood accents, and a soothing palette of sky blues and ochre yellows. Expansive outdoor terraces enveloped in greenery create a seamless indoor-outdoor connection, while burnt sienna screens provide privacy and cast golden light across the living spaces.

The rooftop garden is the highlight of this home, complete with an infinity-edge pool and an outdoor kitchen, offering panoramic views where the jungle meets the sky. Inside, the open-plan living spaces include a state-of-the-art kitchen and double vanity bathrooms with mosaic detailing and soaking tubs, ensuring comfort and sophistication.

Residents enjoy exclusive access to five-star amenities, including a private pool, a cutting-edge fitness center, and vibrant gathering spaces. The Faena District’s Ocean Club, art pavilion, and healing-focused Tierra Santa spa elevate this property beyond a residence—a lifestyle of wellness, creativity, and community.

Embrace the essence of Tulum living in this extraordinary penthouse.

Discover comfort and convenience in this exclusive and fully equipped studio, designed so you can enjoy your vacation to the fullest.

The space includes air conditioning so you can relax in a cool enviroment, a Smart TV for your entertainment, and a luxurious King Size bed that guarantees a good rest, it also has a sofa for greater comfort.

This studio is the perfect choice for those looking for an unforgettable stay with all the amenities at their disposal.

Building amenities (Sea Tower)
------------------------------

Staying near the beach gives you immediate access to the sand and sea, meaning you can enjoy sunrise walks, swim in turquoise waters, or simply relax in the sun at any time. The proximity to the beach also allows you to make the most of water activities like paddleboarding, and more, without having to worry about long commutes. Additionally, you can enjoy the rooftop pool where you can enjoy breathtaking ocean views.

Included features
-----------------

*   Rooftop pool

*   Free underground parking

*   Elevator

*   Wi-Fi

Utilities policy
----------------

To help keep rates competitive, electricity is billed as follows: short stays are limited to 20 kWh per day, with any overages billed at the local utility rate. For stays of 28+ nights, guests pay for electricity based on usage during their stay. For stays of 2+ months, guests are responsible for all utilities (electricity, water, internet, and propane).

**Check-in:** after 3:00 PM  
**Check-out:** before 11:00 AM

Nicolas Lauras•Real Estate Agent

Neighborhood: [Marina Front](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/listings/area/marina-front/)

> Marina-front living offers one of the most peaceful and connected lifestyles in the Mexican Caribbean. Having guided countless families through their relocation to the Riviera Maya, I frequently recommend exploring the marina communities of Puerto Aventuras and Puerto Cancún. Unlike traditional beachfront properties, these homes offer a uniquely refined connection to the water. The calm canals and thoughtfully designed waterfront neighborhoods create an atmosphere that is perfectly suited for everyday living and long-term comfort.
> 
> In these areas, the marina naturally becomes the heart of the community. When I tour spacious 3- and 4-bedroom residences or single-family homes here, clients instantly connect with the seamless indoor-outdoor layouts, expansive terraces, and the convenience of having a private dock right outside their door. It completely transforms daily life. Whether it is enjoying a quiet morning overlooking the water, walking to nearby cafés and boutique shops, or taking the boat out for an afternoon on the Caribbean, the experience is unmatched.
> 
> Because inventory in these highly walkable, secure neighborhoods is naturally limited, true marina-front properties remain incredibly sought-after for those seeking a permanent residence or a welcoming second home. They provide an incredible combination of boating access, privacy, and immediate proximity to world-class amenities, making them the perfect choice for anyone looking to truly integrate into the coastal lifestyle.

#### Property Description

Hidden between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, Cenote Ka’ax is a sanctuary of rare beauty and serenity — one of the Riviera Maya’s most exceptional titled estates. Set amid eight hectares of pristine Mayan jungle, this private retreat harmoniously merges nature, design, and sustainability to create an experience that transcends conventional living. More than a property, it is a destination — a world where time slows, nature breathes, and every element has been thoughtfully crafted to inspire awe.

#### The Heart of the Estate – A Living Cenote

At its center lies a breathtaking freshwater cenote, its crystalline turquoise waters glimmering beneath a canopy of ancient trees. Maintaining a year-round temperature between 24–26°C, it offers the perfect sanctuary for swimming, meditation, or quiet reflection. Three handcrafted **wooden decks** embrace this natural wonder: one at water level for effortless access, another elevated with a **fire pit for evening gatherings**, and a third designed for lounging with panoramic jungle views. Together, they form a sensory experience — where elemental nature meets refined architecture.

#### Refined Comfort & Resort-Level Infrastructure

Cenote Ka’ax is fully developed and ready to operate as a luxury eco-retreat, private estate, or hospitality investment. Seven private jungle cabins are discreetly positioned among the trees, each crafted for privacy and comfort. The property features a restaurant and bar with a professional kitchen, a souvenir and boutique space, and a swimming pool surrounded by lush open gardens.  
A consecrated jungle chapel offers a spiritual setting for intimate weddings and ceremonies, while the spa and temazcal invite wellness seekers to reconnect with nature. An indoor–outdoor gym accommodates both open-air yoga and air-conditioned fitness programs. Additional amenities include a caretaker’s home, walking trails, grill areas, and beautifully landscaped gardens — all interconnected in a seamless, immersive environment.

#### **Flexible Acquisition Options**

This rare estate can be acquired in two distinct configurations:

*   Developed 2-hectare parcel: including the cenote, all existing structures, and full operational infrastructure — offered at $3.2 million USD.
*   Full 8-hectare estate: encompassing the cenote, developed area, and additional jungle acreage ideal for expansion or conservation — offered at $4 million USD.

Both options deliver immediate functionality with exceptional long-term potential for private ownership or boutique hospitality investment.

#### Sustainability Meets Modern Comfort

The estate is powered by CFE electricity, complemented by solar energy and a private well for water supply. Wi-Fi extends throughout the developed area, and a gated entrance ensures privacy and controlled access. This thoughtful balance between modern infrastructure and environmental harmony ensures year-round comfort while preserving the integrity of the surrounding ecosystem.

#### An Investment in Experience & Legacy

Beyond its architectural and natural beauty, Cenote Ka’ax offers a compelling business opportunity. Its existing infrastructure supports daily public access, private events, weddings, retreats, and wellness programs — all within an authentic ecological setting that resonates with the growing global demand for sustainable luxury. Strategically positioned between Playa del Carmen and Tulum, the estate enjoys both seclusion and accessibility, attracting a high-value audience seeking exclusivity and meaning in their travel experiences.

#### A Once-in-a-Lifetime Offering

Few titled properties in the Riviera Maya combine a private cenote, operational facilities, and room for expansion within such a pristine natural environment. With its consecrated chapel, spa, and seven elegant cabins, Cenote Ka’ax embodies the essence of understated luxury — a place where nature, spirituality, and design exist in perfect equilibrium.  
For those who seek more than ownership — for those who wish to preserve beauty, create legacy, and live in harmony with the land — Cenote Ka’ax stands alone.

#### Property Description

Offering an exceptional **yearly cap rate of 12.4%**, this exclusive portfolio represents a rare scale of acquisition in the heart of the Riviera Maya. Featuring two turnkey boutique hotels totaling 51 keys, the offering is engineered for high-yield performance and immediate operational cash flow. Strategically positioned just steps from the cosmopolitan energy of 5th Avenue and the Caribbean coastline, these properties provide a sophisticated entry point into Mexico’s most resilient tourism corridor.

#### Portfolio Composition and Asset Highlights

**Asset I: Modern Luxury Boutique (20 Keys)** A newly constructed, design-driven masterpiece, this property is defined by a contemporary aesthetic and premium finishes. Designed to capture high Average Daily Rates (ADR), the hotel offers a refined guest experience supported by elite infrastructure, including a full-diesel backup generator.

*   **Distinctive Amenities:** A rooftop pool and bar, an on-site full-service restaurant, and a temperature-controlled wine cellar.
*   **Executive Features:** A dedicated cigar lounge and dual-elevator access.
*   **Curated Inventory:** 20 keys comprising Luxury Suites, King Standards, and Double Queen rooms.

**Asset II: Contemporary Turn-Key Urban Retreat (31 Keys)** Located just one block from 5th Avenue, this 31-key hotel caters to a diverse demographic, from leisure travelers to digital nomads. The property balances modern styling with the ease of an urban-coastal lifestyle.

*   **Rooftop Social Space:** Elevated pool and bar area with panoramic views of the city.
*   **Ocean View Living:** The Presidential Suite features a 21 m2 (226 sq ft) terrace offering partial ocean views.
*   **Operational Readiness:** On-site restaurant and versatile room categories ranging from 19 m2 to 49 m2 of interior space.

**Asset II Room Inventory:**

*   Presidential Suite: 49 m2 interior + 21 m2 terrace
*   Loft Suite: 38 m2 interior + 4 m2 balcony
*   Tropical King/Queen: 27 m2 interior + 8 m2 terrace
*   King Suite: 23 m2 interior + 8 m2 terrace
*   Two Queen: 27 m2 interior + 4 m2 balcony
*   Crash Pad: 19 m2 interior + 4 m2 balcony

#### Strategic Investment Rationale

**Prime Connectivity and Location**: This portfolio is situated in the highest-demand zone of Playa del Carmen. Its proximity to world-class dining, vibrant nightlife, and the pristine beaches of the Caribbean Sea ensures exceptional walkability and year-round occupancy.

**Diversified Revenue Streams**: Beyond room revenue, the portfolio is bolstered by multiple income drivers, including two restaurants, two rooftop bars, and specialized spaces like the wine cellar and cigar lounge. This diversification mitigates risk and maximizes the profit potential of the 12.4% yield.

**Scale and Efficiency:** Acquiring 51 keys across two adjacent assets enables significant operational efficiencies. This package is ideal for private equity groups, expanding hospitality brands, or institutional investors seeking a dominant footprint in the Playa del Carmen market.

#### Investment Summary

*   High-Performance Yield: 12.4% yearly cap rate.
*   Total Inventory: 51 total keys across two modern assets.
*   Location: Heart of Playa del Carmen Centro, steps from 5th Avenue.
*   Condition: Turnkey operations with modern infrastructure and premium finishes.

          " Offering an exceptional yearly cap rate of 12.4%, this exclusive portfolio represents a rare scale of acquisition in the heart of the Riviera Maya. Featuring two turnkey boutique hotels totaling 51 keys, the offering is engineered for high-yield performance and immediate operational cash flow. Strategically positioned just steps from the cosmopolitan energy of 5th Avenue and the Caribbean coastline, these properties provide a sophisticated entry point into Mexico’s most resilient tourism corridor.



Portfolio Composition and Asset Highlights



Asset I: Modern Luxury Boutique (20 Keys) A newly constructed, design-driven masterpiece, this property is defined by a contemporary aesthetic and premium finishes. Designed to capture high Average Daily Rates (ADR), the hotel offers a refined guest experience supported by elite infrastructure, including a full-diesel backup generator.




Distinctive Amenities: A rooftop pool and bar, an on-site full-service restaurant, and a temperature-controlled wine cellar.



Executive Features: A dedicated cigar lounge and dual-elevator access.



Curated Inventory: 20 keys comprising Luxury Suites, King Standards, and Double Queen rooms.




Asset II: Contemporary Turn-Key Urban Retreat (31 Keys) Located just one block from 5th Avenue, this 31-key hotel caters to a diverse demographic, from leisure travelers to digital nomads. The property balances modern styling with the ease of an urban-coastal lifestyle.




Rooftop Social Space: Elevated pool and bar area with panoramic views of the city.



Ocean View Living: The Presidential Suite features a 21 m2 (226 sq ft) terrace offering partial ocean views.



Operational Readiness: On-site restaurant and versatile room categories ranging from 19 m2 to 49 m2 of interior space.




Asset II Room Inventory:




Presidential Suite: 49 m2 interior + 21 m2 terrace



Loft Suite: 38 m2 interior + 4 m2 balcony



Tropical King/Queen: 27 m2 interior + 8 m2 terrace



King Suite: 23 m2 interior + 8 m2 terrace



Two Queen: 27 m2 interior + 4 m2 balcony



Crash Pad: 19 m2 interior + 4 m2 balcony




Strategic Investment Rationale



Prime Connectivity and Location: This portfolio is situated in the highest-demand zone of Playa del Carmen. Its proximity to world-class dining, vibrant nightlife, and the pristine beaches of the Caribbean Sea ensures exceptional walkability and year-round occupancy.



Diversified Revenue Streams: Beyond room revenue, the portfolio is bolstered by multiple income drivers, including two restaurants, two rooftop bars, and specialized spaces like the wine cellar and cigar lounge. This diversification mitigates risk and maximizes the profit potential of the 12.4% yield.



Scale and Efficiency: Acquiring 51 keys across two adjacent assets enables significant operational efficiencies. This package is ideal for private equity groups, expanding hospitality brands, or institutional investors seeking a dominant footprint in the Playa del Carmen market.



Investment Summary




High-Performance Yield: 12.4% yearly cap rate.



Total Inventory: 51 total keys across two modern assets.



Location: Heart of Playa del Carmen Centro, steps from 5th Avenue.



Condition: Turnkey operations with modern infrastructure and premium finishes."

Expert Insights on Living and Investing in Playa Centro, Playa del Carmen
-------------------------------------------------------------------------

Local advisor perspectives on what it is like to live and invest in this sought-after neighborhood.

![Jerry Agüero](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/Jerry-Headshot-525x328-1-150x150.jpg)

Jerry Agüero•Real Estate Agent

> Playa Centro is one of those places you understand better when you walk it. Everything feels close. Fifth Avenue runs through the whole area with cafés, restaurants, bars, rooftops, and beach clubs in every direction. And the best part is that every street leads to the beach, which makes daily life feel relaxed and easy.
> 
> Calle 38 is one of my favorite spots. It’s the greenest street in Playa, and it takes you straight to Playa 38, where you can walk along the shore toward Mamitas or Coco Beach. You’ll also find Taquería Sánchez there, easily some of the best tacos in town. For breakfast, I like Cachito, and if you want to eat right by the ocean, Piaggia is always a great choice.
> 
> What I love about this area is how easily people imagine their future here. Some picture slow mornings by the ocean, others see a winter escape, and others want a spot to enjoy their vacations while being in one of the region's best-performing Airbnb markets. And something I notice often is that they end up coming back more and more, escaping here whenever they can because they finally have their own piece of paradise.

#### Property Description

Experience unparalleled luxury in this exquisite 3-bedroom villa located in the exclusive Amanhá community, nestled within the prestigious Yucatan Country Club. Designed to elevate your lifestyle, this residence combines modern sophistication with the natural beauty of its surroundings.

#### Key Features

*   **Spacious Design:** Three bedrooms, each with a full bathroom, a comfortable living and dining area, and a versatile family room.
*   **Indoor-Outdoor Living:** Enjoy a private garden, a rooftop terrace, and a serene pool, perfect for entertaining or unwinding after a day on the golf course.
*   **Premium Amenities:** A fully equipped kitchen, service room, laundry room, and a convenient half bathroom.
*   **Exceptional Extras:** Three dedicated parking spaces, a storage room, and access to contemplative green areas.

#### Community Highlights

*   **Prime Location:** Overlooking the award-winning “El Jaguar” Golf Course, recognized as one of the finest in Mexico, Central, and South America.
*   **World-Class Amenities:** The Yucatan Country Club offers a clubhouse with exclusive restaurants, a luxurious spa, multiple sports facilities, and family-friendly spaces.
*   **Safety & Convenience:** Controlled access with 24/7 security, visitor parking, and meticulously designed walking paths.

This villa offers an unmatched blend of comfort, elegance, and convenience, set in a community designed for those who appreciate the finer things in life.

#### Property Description

This one hectare property in Rancho San Martín is defined by the feature that makes it truly exceptional: three private cenote caves located entirely within its boundaries. These natural formations create an environment that is rare, secluded and deeply connected to the landscape of the Riviera Maya.

The primary cenote is a striking cavern with clear water, sculpted limestone and soft natural light that creates a calm, atmospheric setting. It is an unforgettable place to swim, meditate or share with guests. The two additional cenotes offer their own sense of discovery and provide unique spaces for relaxation, exploration and connection to the region’s ancient geology. Very few private properties in the area can offer anything comparable.

Set 1.7 kilometers inside the gated community of Rancho San Martín, the property provides privacy and a peaceful jungle backdrop while remaining only 15 minutes from the beaches, dining and conveniences of Akumal. Puerto Aventuras and Xpu Ha are a short drive north, and both Tulum and Playa del Carmen are easily accessible for restaurants, wellness and cultural experiences.

The built structures include a four bedroom main home, a one bedroom guest house and a large palapa designed for dining, yoga, workshops or retreat style gatherings. City electricity paired with solar backup ensures comfort and reliability, making the property suitable for full time living or for hosting extended stays and programs.

With its size and natural features, the land offers significant room for thoughtful expansion. Additional guest suites, wellness facilities or creative spaces can be added without impacting the privacy or beauty of the cenotes. The property also lends itself well to a boutique wellness or nature focused retreat concept.

Life here moves at an unhurried pace. Mornings begin with birdsong rising through the canopy, afternoons invite a cool swim in the cenote and evenings gather naturally under the palapa as the night sky settles in.

For buyers seeking something truly rare, this property offers a combination of privacy, ecological richness and long term potential that is difficult to match. The presence of three cenotes creates an experience that is both distinctive and deeply connected to the natural world.

#### Property Description

Positioned along the marina canals of Puerto Aventuras, Nautica presents a rare opportunity to acquire an entire income-producing waterfront building within one of the Riviera Maya’s most established gated communities, **delivering an 8.4% net ROI**. Designed for both immediate revenue and long-term appreciation, the property combines a strategic unit mix with a location that consistently attracts high-quality rental demand.

Set on a generous 1,800.93 m² lot (19,385.06 sq ft) with a total construction area of 988.26 m² (10,639.1 sq ft), the building includes eight fully furnished residences. The layout features four two-bedroom, two-bathroom units and four one-bedroom, one-bathroom units, creating flexibility for short-term vacation rentals, extended stays, or a blended rental strategy. Each residence is delivered turnkey, allowing for seamless operation from day one.

Waterfront positioning is a defining feature. The property fronts directly onto the canal system, with open views toward the marina and constant water movement that enhances both privacy and atmosphere. A private pool is oriented toward the canal, offering a natural focal point for guests, while the surrounding sun terrace and tropical landscaping create inviting outdoor areas that support strong occupancy and guest satisfaction.

Operational efficiency has been carefully considered. Centralized management of the entire building enables streamlined maintenance, a consistent guest experience, and optimized rental performance across all units. On-site parking adds convenience for residents and guests, while the overall design supports a low-friction ownership structure for investors.

Beyond the property itself, the location within Puerto Aventuras continues to drive value. This gated coastal community offers controlled access, a full-service marina, beach access, dining, shops, and essential services, all within a walkable environment. Its reputation for safety, infrastructure, and year-round livability supports both tourism demand and long-term tenancy, reinforcing the asset’s investment profile.

Nautica stands apart as a fully operational waterfront building with scale, positioning, and income potential that are rarely available in this market.

#### Property Description

Delivering a remarkable **13% annual cap rate**, Hotel Kinbe presents a premier opportunity to acquire a high-performing boutique hotel in the heart of Playa del Carmen. This established hospitality asset is a cornerstone of the local luxury market, combining immediate cash-flow stability with significant equity growth potential. Positioned just steps from the vibrant energy of 5th Avenue and the crystalline waters of the Caribbean Sea, the property represents an irreplaceable investment in Mexico’s most coveted destination.

#### The Property and Guest Experience

The architectural design of this four-level property harmonizes modern comfort with the organic elegance of the Riviera Maya. The hotel features 30 sophisticated guest rooms, ranging from tranquil garden-view retreats to a premier penthouse suite offering panoramic ocean views.

The guest experience is defined by a suite of upscale amenities designed for the discerning traveler. A serene pool with a cascading waterfall is set amid lush tropical landscaping, while the rooftop solarium offers a versatile space for sunset gatherings or wellness activities. Guests also benefit from exclusive access to ZENZI Beach Club, further cementing the hotel’s status within the local beachfront community.

#### Strategic Location and Operational Excellence

Hotel Kinbe’s location is irreplaceable. Situated in a high-demand corridor, the property is surrounded by world-class dining, high-end retail, and the natural wonders of the Yucatan Peninsula. Proximity to the Cozumel ferry, renowned cenotes, and the region’s luxury marinas ensures year-round appeal for tourism.

Operationally, the hotel is designed for efficiency and resilience. The infrastructure includes a private electrical substation and a dedicated water treatment system. These features, combined with professional back-of-house facilities, allow for seamless management in a competitive market.

#### Expansion and Value-Add Potential

For the visionary investor, Hotel Kinbe offers a clear path to increased inventory and revenue. The sale includes previously approved architectural plans and a completed foundation study, supporting the development of two additional levels. This expansion capability allows for a strategic increase in room keys or the creation of a flagship rooftop venue, further enhancing the property’s already impressive ROI.

#### Investment Highlights

*   **High-Yield Performance:** 13% yearly cap rate in a premier tourism destination.
*   **Prime Connectivity:** Located less than one hour from Cancun International Airport and steps from 5th Avenue.
*   **Development Ready:** Completed foundation studies for two additional levels (subject to municipal approvals).
*   **Proven Demand:** Strong occupancy history supported by an irreplaceable location near the sand.

          " Delivering a remarkable 13% annual cap rate, Hotel Kinbe presents a premier opportunity to acquire a high-performing boutique hotel in the heart of Playa del Carmen. The Property and Guest Experience 



The architectural design of this four-level property harmonizes modern comfort with the organic elegance of the Riviera Maya. The hotel features 30 sophisticated guest rooms, ranging from tranquil garden-view retreats to a premier penthouse suite offering panoramic ocean views.



The guest experience is defined by a suite of upscale amenities designed for the discerning traveler. A serene pool with a cascading waterfall is set amid lush tropical landscaping, while the rooftop solarium offers a versatile space for sunset gatherings or wellness activities. Guests also benefit from exclusive access to ZENZI Beach Club, further cementing the hotel’s status within the local beachfront community.



Strategic Location and Operational Excellence 



Hotel Kinbe’s location is irreplaceable. Situated in a high-demand corridor, the property is surrounded by world-class dining, high-end retail, and the natural wonders of the Yucatan Peninsula. Proximity to the Cozumel ferry, renowned cenotes, and the region's luxury marinas ensures year-round appeal for tourism.



Operationally, the hotel is designed for efficiency and resilience. The infrastructure includes a private electrical substation and a dedicated water treatment system. These features, combined with professional back-of-house facilities, allow for seamless management in a competitive market.



Expansion and Value-Add Potential 



For the visionary investor, Hotel Kinbe offers a clear path to increased inventory and revenue. The sale includes previously approved architectural plans and a completed foundation study, supporting the development of two additional levels. This expansion capability allows for a strategic increase in room keys or the creation of a flagship rooftop venue, further enhancing the property's already impressive ROI.

#### Property Description

Secure a market-leading **18% NET ROI** yearly with this trophy investment asset. Villa Cielo Azul is a masterclass in modern tropical architecture, specifically engineered to dominate the high-end group rental market in Tulum. Combining massive scale, eco-conscious technology, and a proven revenue model, this five-bedroom sanctuary is the gold standard for income-generating luxury real estate in Region 15.

#### Investment Performance and Property Specs

This property is designed for maximum occupancy and premium nightly rates, outperforming standard vacation rentals through its unique “Mega-Pool” and multi-guest configuration.

*   **Annual Net Yield:** 18% NET ROI (Verified Financials)
*   **Capacity:** Custom-designed to host up to 18 guests comfortably
*   **Land Area:** 490 m² (5,274 sq ft)
*   **Total Construction:** 359.49 m² (3,869 sq ft)
*   **Location:** Region 15, Tulum (Rapid appreciation zone)

#### Architectural Mastery and Guest Amenities

Villa Cielo Azul dissolves the boundaries between curated interiors and the Mayan jungle, featuring floor-to-ceiling glass and expansive open-air living spaces.

#### The Aquatic Centerpiece

The villa boasts one of the largest private swimming pools in the region, spanning 59 square meters (635 sq ft). The dual-depth design (1.3 to 1.6 meters) makes it a versatile focal point for both families and high-end events.

#### Wellness and Entertainment Hubs

*   **Private Yoga Deck:** A professional-grade space for wellness retreats and sound healing.
*   **Immersive Outdoor Cinema:** A unique value-add that drives high booking demand and “Instagrammable” appeal.
*   **Five Luxury Suites:** Every bedroom features an ensuite bathroom, dual vanities, and rainfall showers for a resort-style experience.

#### 2026 Future-Proof Infrastructure

In a region where reliability is a premium, Villa Cielo Azul stands out with a robust, self-sustaining utility stack that ensures 100% uptime for guests.

*   **Solar Power Array:** High-capacity solar integration reducing operational overhead.
*   **Energy Security:** 20kW automated backup generator (Rare for the area).
*   **Connectivity:** High-speed fiber-optic internet for the growing “Work-from-Tulum” demographic.
*   **Sustainability:** Eco-conscious construction aligning with 2026 green building standards.

#### Management and Location Strategy

Situated just five minutes from the Caribbean Sea, this villa offers a secluded jungle atmosphere without sacrificing proximity to Tulum’s world-famous beach clubs and culinary scene.

*   **Turnkey Operations:** Dedicated concierge team and 24/7 on-site security already in place.
*   **Bespoke Services:** Established pipeline for private chefs, yacht charters, and wellness logistics.
*   **Market Position:** Region 15 is currently the most sought-after neighborhood for investors seeking “Next Aldea Zama”- level price appreciation.

#### Summary for the Discerning Investor

Cielo Azul is more than a villa; it is a high-performance financial instrument. With a configuration that sleeps 18 and a 100% autonomous power system, it captures a segment of the market that 95% of other Tulum properties cannot service. This is a premier choice for 1031 exchange buyers or luxury portfolio expansion.

Expert Insights on Living and Investing in Aldea Zama, Tulum
------------------------------------------------------------

Local advisor perspectives on what it is like to live and invest in this sought-after neighborhood.

![Nicolas Lauras](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/01/Nico-Headshot-525x328-1-150x150.jpg)

Nicolas Lauras•Real Estate Agent

> Aldea Zama is one of the most established residential communities in Tulum and is often one of the first areas I introduce to buyers exploring the market. In my experience working with clients in the region, it offers a strong balance of lifestyle appeal, accessibility, and long-term investment potential.
> 
> Unlike many parts of Tulum that developed organically, Aldea Zama was designed as a master-planned community. Residents benefit from paved roads, underground electricity, fiber optic internet, bike paths, and preserved green areas. Certain sections, including Aldea Zama Premium and La Privada, are gated communities with 24-hour security.
> 
> Location is another key advantage. Aldea Zama sits between Tulum’s town center and the beach with convenient access via Avenida Cobá and Kukulcán Boulevard. This allows residents to reach the hotel zone, restaurants, and beach clubs within minutes while still enjoying a quieter residential setting surrounded by jungle.
> 
> Because of its infrastructure, location, and consistent buyer demand, Aldea Zama remains one of the most sought-after areas in the Tulum real estate market. The community offers a mix of condos, villas, and boutique developments designed with Tulum’s signature style of natural materials and indoor-outdoor living.
> 
> For buyers looking for a property that combines lifestyle value with long-term stability in Tulum, Aldea Zama is often one of the strongest communities to consider.

#### Property Description

**Achieve a proven 10% NET ROI yearly with this premier income-generating asset.** Located in the commercial heart of Aldea Zama, this three-level mixed-use building represents a stabilized, high-yield opportunity for institutional and private investors seeking immediate cash flow and long-term appreciation in Mexico’s luxury real estate market.

All units are currently leased to long-term tenants, providing immediate and stable rental income from the moment of acquisition. This established tenancy structure allows the property to operate as a turnkey investment requiring minimal day-to-day management. For buyers seeking to further enhance performance, the property also offers the flexibility to convert some or all units to short-term vacation rentals, which may significantly increase overall returns on investment, depending on the management strategy and market demand.

#### Property Overview and Financial Highlights

This fully titled, turnkey property is a “buy-and-hold” masterpiece. With a total construction area of 592.62 square meters (6,378 square feet), the building is engineered for maximum occupancy and diverse revenue streams.

*   **Annual Net Yield:** 10% NET ROI (Verified)
*   **Total Area:** 592.62 m² (6,378 sq ft)
*   **Location:** Prime Corner Lot, Aldea Zama Commercial Core, Tulum
*   **Asset Type:** Mixed-Use (Commercial + Residential)

#### Diversified Revenue Streams and Configuration

The architectural layout is strategically designed to mitigate risk by balancing long-term commercial leases with high-demand short-term vacation rentals.

#### Ground Floor: Anchor Commercial Tenant

The property’s base features a fully operational, high-traffic restaurant. This stable commercial lease provides a reliable foundation of passive income and benefits from maximum street visibility on a prominent corner.

#### First Level: Luxury Studio Apartments

Two designer studios occupy the middle floor. One unit features an expanded flexible-use space, making it ideal for the “digital nomad” or executive stay market. These units are optimized for high-occupancy platforms like Airbnb and VRBO.

#### Second Level: Penthouse Residence

The top floor is dedicated to a private, upscale one-bedroom penthouse. This suite features premium finishes and provides direct access to the exclusive rooftop amenities, making it a “crown jewel” rental or a private owner’s suite.

#### Luxury Rooftop Amenities

The rooftop serves as a private oasis designed to increase the Average Daily Rate (ADR) for the residential units.

*   **Custom Plunge Pool:** Overlooking the Tulum jungle canopy.
*   **Solarium and Lounge:** Dedicated spaces for wellness and relaxation.
*   **Architectural Views:** 360-degree views of Aldea Zama’s luxury landscape.

#### Strategic Location and Market Value

Aldea Zama is the most prestigious master-planned community in Tulum. This property sits at the epicenter of the zone’s growth, positioned between the future “Green School” and the main beach road.

*   **High Walkability:** Steps from boutique retail, gourmet dining, and wellness centers.
*   **Connectivity:** Seamless access to the new Tulum International Airport and the Maya Train station.
*   **Low Overhead:** Optimized monthly operating costs ensure the 10% net margin remains consistent.

#### Investment Summary for 2026

As Tulum evolves into a global hub for luxury and tech-tourism, properties with “Mixed-Use” zoning in Aldea Zama are the most resilient assets. Whether you are executing a 1031 exchange or diversifying a global portfolio, this building offers the rare combination of architectural beauty and a double-digit net return.

#### Property Description

Don’t miss this extraordinary opportunity to own a spectacular 5-bedroom residence in the prestigious Senderos Mayakoba community of Ciudad Mayakoba – the first fully planned community in the Riviera Maya. This remarkable enclave combines urban luxury with the lush natural beauty of the surrounding landscape, offering an unparalleled lifestyle. With two residential sections connected by scenic pedestrian paths, residents enjoy an immersive experience surrounded by native jungle and a stunning cenote.

#### Property Highlights:

*   Spacious Layout with Luxe Finishes: This brand-new home spans three levels and features five generously sized bedrooms, each with its own ensuite bathroom, plus a convenient half-bath for guests. Buyers can customize finishing touches to make the space uniquely theirs.

#### Property Description

Currently generating an **average 17% Net ROI,** this fully furnished four-bedroom villa offers a rare combination of architectural character and exceptional financial performance. Positioned in a quiet residential neighborhood just six minutes from Tulum’s iconic beaches, the property is both a refined private retreat and a high-performing investment asset. Its strategic proximity to sought-after restaurants and world-class beach clubs ensures consistent demand in Tulum’s premier rental market, combining immediate cash-flow stability with long-term equity growth.

The property sits on a 301-square-meter lot with 245 square meters (2,637 sq. ft.) of interior construction, featuring a layout carefully planned to balance luxury, functionality, and investment scalability.

#### Seamless Indoor-Outdoor Design

The ground level centers around a distinctive sunken living and dining area that opens directly to the terrace through expansive sliding glass doors. Natural light and cross-ventilation enhance the tropical ambiance, while the fully equipped open kitchen and functional bar area make the space ideal for entertaining or extended guest stays.

A lush swim-up pool wraps along the terrace, creating a private resort-style setting. This level includes one king bedroom suite with an en-suite bathroom and walk-in closet, along with a powder room, a laundry room, and fully gated parking for two vehicles.

#### Four En-Suite Bedrooms with Rooftop Expansion Potential

Upstairs, three additional bedrooms each feature private en-suite bathrooms. Two king suites offer generous proportions and calming green views, while a spacious guest room with two queen beds provides the flexibility required for high-occupancy rentals. The primary suite is elegantly appointed, featuring a soaking tub and a rain shower.

The rooftop terrace adds an extra layer of privacy and versatility. A private plunge pool with integrated benches overlooks the surrounding greenery, complemented by sunbathing areas ideal for sunset gatherings. Crucially for the investor, the rooftop has been structurally prepared to accommodate a fifth bedroom, allowing for immediate expansion of both living space and rental yield.

#### Investment & Property Highlights

*   **Strong Yield:** Proven track record with an average **17% Net ROI**.
*   **Expansion Ready:** Engineering in place to add a fifth bedroom on the rooftop.
*   **Dual Private Pools:** Includes both a ground-floor swim-up pool and a rooftop plunge pool.
*   **Turnkey Delivery:** Sold fully furnished and equipped for immediate operation.
*   **Prime Location:** Minutes from the Beach Zone while maintaining a tranquil residential feel.

This villa represents a unique opportunity to secure a piece of Tulum’s signature aesthetic while benefiting from a highly optimized, income-generating engine.

#### Property Description

Immerse yourself in the pinnacle of luxury living with this exceptional 4-bedroom, 5-bathroom condo at SLS Bahia Beach Residences. Situated in the exclusive gated community of Puerto Cancún, this spacious residence combines world-class design, opulent finishes, and access to unparalleled amenities for a lifestyle beyond compare.

#### Condo Highlights

*   **Generous Layout**: Four expansive bedrooms, each with en-suite bathrooms, a family room, and a service room, provide plenty of space for family or guests.
*   **Premium Finishes**: Marble floors throughout, custom-designed walk-in closets, and a chef’s kitchen featuring granite countertops and high-end appliances ensure every detail is of the highest quality.
*   **Private Outdoor Space**: A large terrace offers breathtaking marina or garden views, creating the perfect setting for morning coffee or evening gatherings.
*   **Modern Comforts**: Equipped with high-efficiency concealed air conditioning systems and contemporary bathroom fixtures for ultimate convenience.

#### Unrivaled Amenities

*   **Private Beach Club**: Enjoy access to an exclusive beach club with premium dining options and comfortable lounges.
*   **Infinity Pools**: Take in stunning marina and ocean views from infinity-edge pools with poolside cabanas and towel service.
*   **Ciel Spa Membership**: Relax and rejuvenate with access to steam rooms, massage therapy, and other luxurious treatments.
*   **Fitness Center**: A fully equipped gym offering state-of-the-art cardio, weight training machines, yoga mats, and more.
*   **Exclusive Entertainment Areas**: A media room, teen lounge, and the Club Room Lounge are perfect for entertaining guests or enjoying family time.

#### Premier Location in Puerto Cancún

*   Direct access to a 175-slip private marina for vessels of all sizes.
*   The Tom Weiskopf-designed 18-hole golf course for an extraordinary golfing experience.
*   Over 50,000 square meters of shopping, including more than 100 boutiques and an array of gourmet restaurants.
*   A 16-theater cinema and 24-hour entertainment options are all within reach.

#### Concierge and Hotel Services

Residents benefit from 24/7 personalized concierge services provided by the neighboring SLS Cancún Hotel. Enjoy assistance with housekeeping, valet parking, grocery delivery, babysitting, and more, ensuring effortless luxury living.

#### About SLS Bahia Beach Residences

Designed by Sofia Aspe Interiorismo, this iconic 20-story tower is a masterpiece of modern architecture. Featuring museum-quality art installations, eco-friendly landscaping, and innovative amenities, SLS Bahia Beach redefines urban coastal living in Puerto Cancún.

Seize the opportunity to own this spectacular 4-bedroom condo at SLS Bahia Beach, where elegance meets exclusivity.

          " Immerse yourself in the pinnacle of luxury living with this exceptional 4-bedroom, 5-bathroom condo at SLS Bahia Beach Residences. Situated in the exclusive gated community of Puerto Cancún, this spacious residence combines world-class design, opulent finishes, and access to unparalleled amenities for a lifestyle beyond compare.



Condo Highlights




Generous Layout: Four expansive bedrooms, each with en-suite bathrooms, a family room, and a service room, provide plenty of space for family or guests.



Premium Finishes: Marble floors throughout, custom-designed walk-in closets, and a chef’s kitchen featuring granite countertops and high-end appliances ensure every detail is of the highest quality.



Private Outdoor Space: A large terrace offers breathtaking marina or garden views, creating the perfect setting for morning coffee or evening gatherings.



Modern Comforts: Equipped with high-efficiency concealed air conditioning systems and contemporary bathroom fixtures for ultimate convenience.




Unrivaled Amenities




Private Beach Club: Enjoy access to an exclusive beach club with premium dining options and comfortable lounges.



Infinity Pools: Take in stunning marina and ocean views from infinity-edge pools with poolside cabanas and towel service.



Ciel Spa Membership: Relax and rejuvenate with access to steam rooms, massage therapy, and other luxurious treatments.



Fitness Center: A fully equipped gym offering state-of-the-art cardio, weight training machines, yoga mats, and more.



Exclusive Entertainment Areas: A media room, teen lounge, and the Club Room Lounge are perfect for entertaining guests or enjoying family time.




Premier Location in Puerto Cancún




Direct access to a 175-slip private marina for vessels of all sizes.



The Tom Weiskopf-designed 18-hole golf course for an extraordinary golfing experience.



Over 50,000 square meters of shopping, including more than 100 boutiques and an array of gourmet restaurants.



A 16-theater cinema and 24-hour entertainment options are all within reach.




Concierge and Hotel Services



Residents benefit from 24/7 personalized concierge services provided by the neighboring SLS Cancún Hotel. Enjoy assistance with housekeeping, valet parking, grocery delivery, babysitting, and more, ensuring effortless luxury living.



About SLS Bahia Beach Residences



Designed by Sofia Aspe Interiorismo, this iconic 20-story tower is a masterpiece of modern architecture. Featuring museum-quality art installations, eco-friendly landscaping, and innovative amenities, SLS Bahia Beach redefines urban coastal living in Puerto Cancún.



Seize the opportunity to own this spectacular 4-bedroom condo at SLS Bahia Beach, where elegance meets exclusivity."

#### Property Description

Escape to an exceptional retreat where nature, privacy, and purposeful design converge. Tucked into the heart of the jungle and only minutes from the Caribbean Sea, this remarkable 2.5-acre (10,000 m²) estate offers a life immersed in tranquility—yet just a short drive from the vibrant amenities of Puerto Aventuras, Xpu Ha, and Akumal. Whether you’re seeking a personal haven, a family sanctuary, or the perfect location for a boutique retreat, this property invites you to live with intention and elegance.

#### A Self-Sufficient Jungle Retreat

At the core of the estate are two architecturally conscious homes, designed to harmonize with the surrounding landscape. Together, they offer approximately 1,900 square feet of interior space, including 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and versatile rooms that can serve as guest accommodations, creative studios, or wellness spaces. Every element has been carefully crafted for comfort and self-reliance, powered by solar energy, with water storage systems in place, ensuring true off-grid independence.

Outdoor living is central to the experience. Expansive terraces and shaded lounges provide the perfect setting for dining, yoga, or simple moments of stillness under the jungle canopy. Surrounded by vibrant tropical flora and wildlife, every inch of the property is an invitation to slow down and reconnect.

#### Your Own Private Cenote — A Natural Wonder

A rare and sacred feature, the estate’s private cenote cave offers something truly extraordinary. Imagine descending into this natural sanctuary, its crystalline waters offering cool relief and profound stillness. Whether for meditation, swimming, or creating unforgettable experiences with family and guests, this cenote is more than a feature; it’s a soul-stirring focal point, rarely found and impossible to replicate.

#### **Endless Possibilities for Living or Hosting**

This estate isn’t just a home, it’s a canvas for vision. With expansive land and fully sustainable infrastructure, the property is ideal for a wide range of uses: from a luxurious family compound to a boutique wellness retreat or eco-tourism concept. The rich soil and ample space invite permaculture gardens, additional structures, or curated outdoor amenities. All this, while maintaining total privacy in the heart of the jungle.

#### A World Apart, Yet Close to Everything

Despite its secluded setting, the property is incredibly well-located, just 15 minutes from world-class beaches, beach clubs, fine dining, grocery stores, and a golf course. And with Cancun International Airport just 1 hour and 15 minutes away, welcoming guests or traveling becomes effortlessly convenient. Whether you’re here full-time, hosting visitors, or developing a hospitality concept, this location offers the perfect blend of seclusion and access.

#### Bring Your Vision to Life

This is more than real estate, it’s an opportunity to create something deeply personal, meaningful, and enduring. Whether you’re drawn to wellness, sustainability, or the dream of off-grid luxury living, this jungle sanctuary offers the space, freedom, and inspiration to bring your vision to life.

          " Escape to an exceptional retreat where nature, privacy, and purposeful design converge. Tucked into the heart of the jungle and only minutes from the Caribbean Sea, this remarkable 2.5-acre (10,000 m²) estate offers a life immersed in tranquility—yet just a short drive from the vibrant amenities of Puerto Aventuras, Xpu Ha, and Akumal. Whether you're seeking a personal haven, a family sanctuary, or the perfect location for a boutique retreat, this property invites you to live with intention and elegance.



A Self-Sufficient Jungle Retreat



At the core of the estate are two architecturally conscious homes, designed to harmonize with the surrounding landscape. Together, they offer approximately 1,900 square feet of interior space, including 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, and versatile rooms that can serve as guest accommodations, creative studios, or wellness spaces. Every element has been carefully crafted for comfort and self-reliance, powered by solar energy, with water storage systems in place, ensuring true off-grid independence.



Outdoor living is central to the experience. Expansive terraces and shaded lounges provide the perfect setting for dining, yoga, or simple moments of stillness under the jungle canopy. Surrounded by vibrant tropical flora and wildlife, every inch of the property is an invitation to slow down and reconnect.



Your Own Private Cenote — A Natural Wonder



A rare and sacred feature, the estate’s private cenote cave offers something truly extraordinary. Imagine descending into this natural sanctuary, its crystalline waters offering cool relief and profound stillness. Whether for meditation, swimming, or creating unforgettable experiences with family and guests, this cenote is more than a feature; it’s a soul-stirring focal point, rarely found and impossible to replicate.



Endless Possibilities for Living or Hosting



This estate isn’t just a home, it’s a canvas for vision. With expansive land and fully sustainable infrastructure, the property is ideal for a wide range of uses: from a luxurious family compound to a boutique wellness retreat or eco-tourism concept. The rich soil and ample space invite permaculture gardens, additional structures, or curated outdoor amenities. All this, while maintaining total privacy in the heart of the jungle.



A World Apart, Yet Close to Everything



Despite its secluded setting, the property is incredibly well-located, just 15 minutes from world-class beaches, beach clubs, fine dining, grocery stores, and a golf course. And with Cancun International Airport just 1 hour and 15 minutes away, welcoming guests or traveling becomes effortlessly convenient. Whether you're here full-time, hosting visitors, or developing a hospitality concept, this location offers the perfect blend of seclusion and access.



Bring Your Vision to Life



This is more than real estate, it’s an opportunity to create something deeply personal, meaningful, and enduring. Whether you're drawn to wellness, sustainability, or the dream of off-grid luxury living, this jungle sanctuary offers the space, freedom, and inspiration to bring your vision to life."

Expert Insights on Living and Investing in Puerto Cancun, Cancun
----------------------------------------------------------------

Local advisor perspectives on what it is like to live and invest in this sought-after neighborhood.

![Mikel García Bárcena](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/06/Mikel-Open-Arms-copy-150x150.jpg)

Mikel García Bárcena•Cancun Real Estate Agent

> Puerto Cancún is where the city’s energy meets refinement, offering a lifestyle built around water, access, and exclusivity. Set between downtown Cancún and the Hotel Zone, this master-planned community brings together marina living, private residences, a world-class golf course, and upscale retail in a gated, pedestrian-friendly setting. Daily life unfolds alongside canals, mangroves, and the Caribbean Sea, creating a rare sense of calm without sacrificing connectivity.
> 
> One of the simplest ways to understand it is an evening at Hiromi, overlooking the marina at sunset. I always come back to the Harumi roll, it’s one of those dishes you start craving before you even sit down. Pair it with the view and the pace of Puerto Cancún, and it makes sense right away.
> 
> From an investment standpoint, Puerto Cancún benefits from scarce land, strict planning, and consistent demand from high-net-worth buyers seeking security and long-term value. While Cancún is still a young city, Puerto Cancún has matured into one of its most stable and prestigious markets. It is not defined by tourism alone, but by a community built for living well, where lifestyle, privacy, and value align naturally.

#### Property Description

Experience refined coastal living at Casa Blake, the iconic centerpiece of the Marina Village at Costa Palmas. This elegant 2-bedroom residence offers a seamless blend of sophisticated design, comfort, and convenience, all set against the breathtaking backdrop of the Sea of Cortez.

Designed with warm, inviting interiors, this turnkey residence features an open-concept living and dining area that serves as the heart of the home. The spacious master bedroom offers a private retreat with an indulgent spa-like en-suite bathroom and a generous vanity area. Expansive terraces extend your living space outdoors, allowing you to soak in the panoramic views of the marina and the sparkling sea beyond.

As a resident of Casa Blake, you’ll enjoy exclusive access to world-class amenities, including a marina-side infinity pool, an open-air lounge and bar, a signature brasserie-style restaurant, a state-of-the-art fitness center, and lush garden retreats. Ownership at Casa Blake also connects you to the greater Costa Palmas community, spanning 1,500 acres of luxury, including a Robert Trent Jones II golf course, a private beach club, and access to the region’s only deep-water marina—a premier destination for yacht enthusiasts.

Beyond the 2-bedroom residences, Casa Blake offers a variety of floorplans to suit different lifestyles, including studios, 1-bedroom condos, 3-bedroom residences, and expansive 4-bedroom residences. Whether you’re looking for a cozy retreat or a spacious waterfront sanctuary, Casa Blake provides an unparalleled ownership opportunity in one of Baja’s most exclusive coastal destinations.

For more details on availability and pricing, contact us today.
