#### Property Description

Experience an unparalleled lifestyle of elegance and exclusivity in this stunning 3-bedroom, 4-bathroom condo at SLS Bahia Beach Residences, located in the prestigious community of Puerto Cancún. Combining contemporary design with luxurious finishes, this residence offers an idyllic retreat for those who value sophistication and comfort.

#### Condo Highlights

*   **Expansive Layout**: This residence boasts three spacious bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom, a family room, and a dedicated service room.
*   **Luxury Finishes**: Marble flooring flows throughout, complemented by high-end carpentry and a sleek gourmet kitchen featuring granite countertops, custom cabinetry, and premium appliances.
*   **Private Terrace**: Enjoy breathtaking marina or garden views from your private outdoor space, perfect for relaxing or entertaining guests.
*   **Modern Conveniences**: Equipped with high-efficiency air conditioning systems and state-of-the-art fixtures for seamless living.

#### World-Class Amenities

*   **Private Beach Club**: Exclusive access to a private beach club offering upscale dining and relaxing lounges.
*   **Infinity Pools**: Soak in the spectacular marina or beach views from the serene infinity pools with towel service.
*   **Ciel Spa Access**: Indulge in luxurious treatments, herbal steam rooms, and massage facilities at the renowned **Ciel Spa**.
*   **Fitness Center**: A fully equipped gym with options for yoga, Pilates, weight training, and cardio.
*   **Entertainment Spaces**: Residents can enjoy a media room, teen lounge, and private Club Room Lounge for socializing or hosting events.

#### Unmatched Location in Puerto Cancún

Located in **Novo Cancún**, this residence offers easy access to:

*   A 175-slip private marina accommodating vessels of all sizes.
*   The Tom Weiskopf-designed golf course.
*   Over 50,000 square meters of shopping with over 100 boutiques, fine dining options, and a 16-theater cinema complex.
*   Miles of natural beauty, including nearby ecological reserves and canals.

#### Premium Concierge and Hotel Services

As a resident, you’ll enjoy 24/7 concierge services from the neighboring SLS Cancún Hotel, including housekeeping, valet parking, grocery delivery, pet care, and more. Personalized attention ensures your every need is met.

#### About SLS Bahia Beach Residences

This 20-story luxury tower, designed by Sofia Aspe Interiorismo, is a masterpiece of modern architecture. With curated art installations, lush green spaces, and cutting-edge amenities, it sets a new standard for coastal living in Puerto Cancún.

Elevate your lifestyle with this exquisite 3-bedroom condo at SLS Bahia Beach, where luxury and leisure meet.

          " Experience an unparalleled lifestyle of elegance and exclusivity in this stunning 3-bedroom, 4-bathroom condo at SLS Bahia Beach Residences, located in the prestigious community of Puerto Cancún. Combining contemporary design with luxurious finishes, this residence offers an idyllic retreat for those who value sophistication and comfort.



Condo Highlights




Expansive Layout: This residence boasts three spacious bedrooms, each with its own en-suite bathroom, a family room, and a dedicated service room.



Luxury Finishes: Marble flooring flows throughout, complemented by high-end carpentry and a sleek gourmet kitchen featuring granite countertops, custom cabinetry, and premium appliances.



Private Terrace: Enjoy breathtaking marina or garden views from your private outdoor space, perfect for relaxing or entertaining guests.



Modern Conveniences: Equipped with high-efficiency air conditioning systems and state-of-the-art fixtures for seamless living.




World-Class Amenities




Private Beach Club: Exclusive access to a private beach club offering upscale dining and relaxing lounges.



Infinity Pools: Soak in the spectacular marina or beach views from the serene infinity pools with towel service.



Ciel Spa Access: Indulge in luxurious treatments, herbal steam rooms, and massage facilities at the renowned Ciel Spa.



Fitness Center: A fully equipped gym with options for yoga, Pilates, weight training, and cardio.



Entertainment Spaces: Residents can enjoy a media room, teen lounge, and private Club Room Lounge for socializing or hosting events.




Unmatched Location in Puerto Cancún



Located in Novo Cancún, this residence offers easy access to:




A 175-slip private marina accommodating vessels of all sizes.



The Tom Weiskopf-designed golf course.



Over 50,000 square meters of shopping with over 100 boutiques, fine dining options, and a 16-theater cinema complex.



Miles of natural beauty, including nearby ecological reserves and canals.




Premium Concierge and Hotel Services



As a resident, you'll enjoy 24/7 concierge services from the neighboring SLS Cancún Hotel, including housekeeping, valet parking, grocery delivery, pet care, and more. Personalized attention ensures your every need is met.



About SLS Bahia Beach Residences



This 20-story luxury tower, designed by Sofia Aspe Interiorismo, is a masterpiece of modern architecture. With curated art installations, lush green spaces, and cutting-edge amenities, it sets a new standard for coastal living in Puerto Cancún.



Elevate your lifestyle with this exquisite 3-bedroom condo at SLS Bahia Beach, where luxury and leisure meet."

#### Property Description

Discover the pinnacle of modern living at SLS Bahia Beach Residences, a premier address nestled in the heart of Puerto Cancún. This exclusive 2-bedroom, 2.5-bathroom condo offers a perfect blend of elegance, comfort, and luxury within a gated community renowned for its world-class amenities and serene surroundings.

#### Condo Highlights

*   **Spacious Layout**: The thoughtfully designed floor plan includes two bedrooms with en-suite bathrooms, a stylish guest half-bath, and a versatile family space.
*   **Elegant Finishes**: Enjoy marble flooring throughout, a gourmet kitchen with granite countertops, and top-of-the-line appliances. The private terrace provides a seamless connection to breathtaking marina views.
*   **Modern Comforts**: High-efficiency, concealed air-conditioning systems ensure year-round comfort.

#### Exclusive Amenities

*   Access to a private beach club with dining and lounge options.
*   A 175-slip marina, accommodating vessels of all sizes.
*   Serene infinity pools with towel service and panoramic marina views.
*   Membership to the Ciel Spa, offering herbal steam rooms, massage beds, and experience showers.
*   A state-of-the-art fitness center with equipment for yoga, Pilates, and cardio.
*   Exclusive residents-only lounges, media rooms, and entertainment spaces.

#### Prime Location in Puerto Cancún

SLS Bahia Beach is strategically located near Puerto Cancún’s top attractions:

*   The Tom Weiskopf-designed 18-hole golf course.
*   Over 50,000 square meters of premium shopping, including 100+ boutiques.
*   A vibrant dining and entertainment district with cinemas and live events.

#### Concierge and Hotel Services

Residents enjoy access to concierge services from the neighboring SLS Cancún Hotel, including housekeeping, room service, valet parking, and more. Additional offerings like grocery shopping, laundry, and pet-sitting ensure effortless luxury living.

#### About SLS Bahia Beach Residences

This 20-story architectural marvel, designed by Sofia Aspe Interiorismo, is adorned with museum-quality artwork curated by the Related Group. The lush landscaping, eco-friendly design, and unmatched service redefine the standards of urban coastal living.

Elevate your lifestyle with this extraordinary 2-bedroom condo at SLS Bahia Beach. Don’t miss the opportunity to call this haven of luxury your home.

#### Property Description

Experience a lifestyle of wellness and luxury in this stunning 3-bedroom condo located within BLAS, Puerto Cancún’s most exclusive residential community. Designed with biophilic principles to harmonize natural elements with modern living, BLAS offers a serene escape where every detail has been meticulously crafted for balance and tranquility.

This spacious condo features:

*   **Three Bedrooms:** Each room is thoughtfully designed to maximize comfort and style, providing a private oasis for relaxation.
*   **State-of-the-Art Amenities:** Residents enjoy access to premium features such as a rooftop sky pool, spa, indoor and outdoor gyms, and a sky kitchen. The complex also includes tennis and paddle courts, a golf simulator, coworking spaces, and a kids’ club.
*   **Breathtaking Views:** Large terraces allow you to soak in panoramic vistas of Puerto Cancún’s pristine canals and lush landscapes.
*   **Exclusive Location:** Nestled in the heart of Puerto Cancún, residents have direct access to upscale dining, boutique shopping, a championship golf course, and a private marina.

Architectural Excellence The interiors of BLAS are the vision of award-winning architect Filipao Nunes, blending cutting-edge design with functionality to create spaces that elevate everyday living.

Why Choose BLAS? Puerto Cancún is an icon of the Mexican Caribbean, offering an unparalleled lifestyle where nature, luxury, and recreation converge. At BLAS, enjoy a seamless connection to the sea, open skies, and world-class amenities that enhance your quality of life.

Your Sanctuary Awaits Don’t miss the opportunity to own a piece of paradise in this sought-after development.

Three Bedrooms: Each room is thoughtfully designed to maximize comfort and style, providing a private oasis for relaxation.



State-of-the-Art Amenities: Residents enjoy access to premium features such as a rooftop sky pool, spa, indoor and outdoor gyms, and a sky kitchen. The complex also includes tennis and paddle courts, a golf simulator, coworking spaces, and a kids’ club.



Breathtaking Views: Large terraces allow you to soak in panoramic vistas of Puerto Cancún’s pristine canals and lush landscapes.



Exclusive Location: Nestled in the heart of Puerto Cancún, residents have direct access to upscale dining, boutique shopping, a championship golf course, and a private marina.




Architectural Excellence The interiors of BLAS are the vision of award-winning architect Filipao Nunes, blending cutting-edge design with functionality to create spaces that elevate everyday living.

#### Property Description

Welcome to Gran Península, an exclusive waterfront sanctuary in Puerto Aventuras, where sophistication meets the serenity of the Riviera Maya. This magnificent 4-bedroom, 5-bathroom residence embodies the pinnacle of ultra-luxury living, offering an unparalleled blend of modern elegance, breathtaking marina views, and world-class amenities in one of the most prestigious communities in Mexico.

#### A Masterpiece of Design & Craftsmanship

Impeccably designed with the finest materials and meticulous attention to detail, this residence redefines coastal luxury. Floor-to-ceiling windows frame panoramic views of the marina, while expansive cantilevered terraces provide an exquisite indoor-outdoor living experience. The interiors are adorned with bespoke wood finishes, premium stone surfaces, and state-of-the-art lighting, creating an atmosphere of refined sophistication.

The sprawling primary suite is a private retreat, featuring a spa-inspired en-suite bathroom, walk-in dressing area, and an exclusive terrace overlooking the waterfront. Each additional bedroom offers exceptional privacy, opulent finishes, and en-suite baths, ensuring comfort and exclusivity for residents and guests alike. The designer kitchen, equipped with high-end appliances and custom cabinetry, seamlessly integrates with the open-concept living and dining areas, making it an entertainer’s dream.

#### Unrivaled Amenities & Private Marina Access

Gran Península offers an exclusive selection of resort-inspired amenities, ensuring a lifestyle of sophistication and indulgence. Residents enjoy private marina access, a luxurious infinity-edge pool, a rooftop lounge with panoramic ocean views, and a world-class fitness and wellness center. The development is complemented by meticulously landscaped gardens, a private spa, a fire-lit social lounge, and an exclusive members’ concierge service, catering to your every need.

#### The Ultimate Riviera Maya Address

Nestled within the ultra-secure, gated community of Puerto Aventuras, Gran Península offers effortless access to pristine beaches, a private golf course, fine dining, and high-end boutiques. Just 23 minutes from Playa del Carmen and 35 minutes from Tulum, this prestigious residence is perfectly positioned to experience the best of the Riviera Maya while enjoying the utmost privacy and exclusivity.

A residence of this caliber is a rare find. Discover a new level of waterfront luxury at Gran Península. Contact us today to secure your private tour.

#### Property Description

Viceroy Residences Playa del Carmen introduces a branded residential offering in a prime beachside setting near Calle 38, one of the city’s most beautiful and established streets. Planned as an intimate six-story development, the project combines refined contemporary design with Viceroy’s hospitality-led service approach, private beach club access, and a carefully curated collection of wellness and lifestyle amenities.

Residences are designed for bright, open indoor-outdoor living, with private terraces extending from the main living areas and bedrooms through sliding glass doors. Interiors are planned with open kitchens, travertine-tone countertops and backsplashes, premium Italian cabinetry, integrated dining areas, 9.2-foot (2.8 m) ceilings in living spaces, walk-in closets in primary bedrooms, spa-inspired bathrooms, imported European porcelain flooring, and a top-tier stainless steel appliance package. The offering includes one to four-bedroom layouts, select den configurations, and larger penthouse residences.

Residents will enjoy three rooftop infinity pools, a beach club, spa, fitness center, yoga and meditation spaces, business and social areas, and a dedicated residential hospitality team. Residences currently range from approximately $370,000 USD for a one-bedroom residence to about $4,000,000 USD for a four-bedroom penthouse plus den.

#### Property Description

Immerse yourself in the refined elegance of Casa Leona, a stunning residence situated in the prestigious, gated community of Puerto Aventuras. Nestled beside the tranquil fairways, this architectural gem offers over 9,100 square feet of thoughtfully crafted living space, where timeless design meets modern comfort.

As you step inside, the home’s artistry immediately enchants you. The formal living and dining areas feature intricate domed brick ceilings and gracefully arched windows, allowing abundant natural light to fill the space. These areas flow seamlessly into an expansive terrace, creating a harmonious blend of indoor and outdoor living. The terrace opens to a magnificent pool area, making this home ideal for entertaining or simply savoring peaceful evenings with golf course views.

#### Spacious and Elegant Accommodations

Casa Leona features 4 generously sized bedrooms, each boasting a private terrace and an ensuite bathroom. Luxurious hardwood floors grace the bedrooms, while elegant marble flooring enhances the rest of the home. A ground-floor bedroom provides added convenience and versatility, while two additional half-baths—one conveniently located poolside—ensure comfort for residents and guests alike.

#### A Culinary Haven

The heart of this home is its Italian-designed kitchen, a dream for culinary enthusiasts. Equipped with high-end imported appliances and featuring sophisticated cabinetry and rich hardwood floors, this space combines functionality with aesthetic appeal.

#### **Exceptional Amenities and Features**

A two-story library offers a serene retreat for reading or relaxation, featuring intricate woodwork, custom wrought-iron details, and grand chandeliers. The staircase leading to the second floor is a statement of artistry and elegance, serving as the home’s focal point.

Step outside to discover a lushly landscaped backyard, complete with a sparkling pool and private access to the verdant golf course surroundings. For pet lovers, a dedicated dog park and grooming area provide unique conveniences. Mature trees envelop the 1,300-square-meter property, creating a natural sanctuary that enhances privacy and tranquility.

#### The Ultimate in Luxury Living

Casa Leona exemplifies sophistication and comfort, offering a rare opportunity to own a home that masterfully combines exclusivity, beauty, and lifestyle. Its location in the sought-after Puerto Aventuras community further elevates its appeal, making it an exceptional choice for discerning buyers.

          " Immerse yourself in the refined elegance of Casa Leona, a stunning residence situated in the prestigious, gated community of Puerto Aventuras. As you step inside, the home’s artistry immediately enchants you. The formal living and dining areas feature intricate domed brick ceilings and gracefully arched windows, allowing abundant natural light to fill the space. These areas flow seamlessly into an expansive terrace, creating a harmonious blend of indoor and outdoor living. The terrace opens to a magnificent pool area, making this home ideal for entertaining or simply savoring peaceful evenings with golf course views.



Spacious and Elegant Accommodations

Luxurious hardwood floors grace the bedrooms, while elegant marble flooring enhances the rest of the home. A ground-floor bedroom provides added convenience and versatility, while two additional half-baths—one conveniently located poolside—ensure comfort for residents and guests alike.



A Culinary Haven



The heart of this home is its Italian-designed kitchen, a dream for culinary enthusiasts. Equipped with high-end imported appliances and featuring sophisticated cabinetry and rich hardwood floors, this space combines functionality with aesthetic appeal.



Exceptional Amenities and Features

Step outside to discover a lushly landscaped backyard, complete with a sparkling pool and private access to the verdant golf course surroundings. For pet lovers, a dedicated dog park and grooming area provide unique conveniences. Mature trees envelop the 1,300-square-meter property, creating a natural sanctuary that enhances privacy and tranquility.



The Ultimate in Luxury Living



Casa Leona exemplifies sophistication and comfort, offering a rare opportunity to own a home that masterfully combines exclusivity, beauty, and lifestyle. Its location in the sought-after Puerto Aventuras community further elevates its appeal, making it an exceptional choice for discerning buyers."

#### Property Description

Positioned at the top of the boutique Artesan Timeless Residences in Puerto Aventuras, this three-bedroom penthouse offers a rare combination of architectural design, privacy, and elevated outdoor living within one of the Riviera Maya’s most established gated communities. With just 11 residences in the building, the project maintains a scale that feels intentional and residential rather than high-density.

The penthouse features approximately 151 m² (1,625 sq ft) of interior living space, complemented by a 22.8 m² (245 sq ft) main terrace, with the added benefit of a private rooftop terrace that significantly expands the usable outdoor area. The total layout is designed to maximize both functionality and lifestyle, offering three bedrooms and three full bathrooms.

The main level centers around an open living and dining area that connects directly to the terrace, creating a natural extension of the interior space. Large openings allow for consistent natural light and ventilation, while maintaining a comfortable sense of privacy. The kitchen is efficiently integrated into the main living area, designed for both everyday use and entertaining.

Upstairs, the private rooftop terrace becomes a defining feature of the penthouse. Designed as an outdoor living space, it includes a jacuzzi and ample room for lounging, dining, or hosting, all while enjoying views toward the marina and the Caribbean Sea. This elevated space creates a clear distinction from standard condominium living, offering a level of privacy and flexibility that is difficult to replicate.

Each bedroom is positioned to provide separation and comfort, making the residence well-suited for full-time living, extended stays, or short-term rental use. The overall design reflects a strong architectural concept, where layered façades, structural elements, and natural materials come together to create a residence with a clear identity.

Residents of Artesan benefit from a curated selection of amenities, including a 22-meter infinity pool, rooftop lounge with panoramic views, gym, solarium, jacuzzi areas, elevator access, and dedicated parking. The development also includes infrastructure for electric golf cart charging, aligning with the lifestyle of Puerto Aventuras.

Located within a secure, master-planned community, the property provides access to a private marina, golf course, beach access, restaurants, and everyday conveniences, all within a walkable environment. Its location places it approximately 45 minutes from Cancun International Airport and about 60 minutes from Tulum Airport, offering convenient access for both residents and guests.

This penthouse stands out for its combination of architectural quality, private rooftop living, and its position within a well-established coastal community, making it a strong option for both personal use and long-term investment.

Christie MacKay•Listing Agent

> La Veleta is one of Tulum’s most energetic neighborhoods, and you feel it from the first light of day. Along Calle 7, mornings start with yogis, runners, and early risers grabbing coffee and fresh baked goods at Nimeno, smoothies at Otti, or heading to nearby studios for a workout.
> 
> By midday, the sidewalks take on a boutique feel. Shop owners set out displays of clothing, jewelry, and artisan pieces for the home, while lunch aromas drift from local favorites like La Taqueria and La Norteña, with Billy Bob’s keeping the grill going.
> 
> As evening arrives, La Veleta leans into its signature atmosphere. Jungle Jax fires up a chef-owned kitchen in a garden setting, Asian Bodega brings bold flavors, and La Pizzine and Canova heat their ovens, while Veleta Market buzzes with choices.
> 
> After dinner, the music takes over, from Tuesday nights at Raum to weekend DJ sets at Veleta Market, and late nights at Mera Room.

#### Property Description

Nestled along the scenic fairways of the Puerto Aventuras golf course, Villa Victoria is a refined four-bedroom residence offering privacy, tranquility, and effortless living. Designed with intention and care, this home is situated within one of the most established gated communities in the Riviera Maya, blending nature, leisure, and comfort in perfect harmony.

Ideal for families, remote professionals, or those seeking a peaceful base to enjoy the beauty and amenities of the Caribbean coast.

#### What Makes This Property Special

*   Light-Filled Living Spaces
    *   With expansive windows, high ceilings, and premium materials, the home welcomes natural light and provides a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor areas, making it ideal for year-round Caribbean living.
*   Chef-Inspired Kitchen
    *   Featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a professional-grade gas cooktop, the kitchen is both functional and beautiful, ideally suited for both everyday meals and entertaining guests.
*   Private Pool & Lush Gardens
    *   The outdoor space includes a two-tiered swimming pool with shaded areas and a shallow zone for children. Mature greenery provides natural privacy and a serene atmosphere for relaxing or hosting.
*   Elegant Primary Suite
    *   Unwind in your spacious master bedroom with a spa-style bathroom featuring a jacuzzi tub, dual sinks, and a private terrace overlooking the golf course.
*   Sustainable, Thoughtful Design
    *   Villa Victoria is solar-equipped with 12 rooftop panels, has its own water well for irrigation and pool, and includes hurricane shutters discreetly tucked away when not in use. A raised foundation adds further protection and peace of mind.
*   Magical Evenings
    *   As the sun sets, the villa is bathed in a soft glow, perfect for evening dips, gatherings with loved ones, or simply enjoying a quiet night under the stars.

#### The Puerto Aventuras Lifestyle

This secure, master-planned community offers an unmatched coastal experience:

*   Access to white-sand beaches and calm Caribbean waters
*   Private marina for yachts and sailing
*   Golf course, tennis courts, fitness studios, and yoga
*   A vibrant town center with shops, restaurants, and bilingual schools
*   Family-friendly and pet-friendly environment with walkable streets
*   High-speed internet for seamless remote work
*   Minutes to Tulum, cenotes, ancient ruins, and eco-adventures

#### Why Choose Villa Victoria

*   Located in one of the Riviera Maya’s safest and most desirable neighborhoods
*   Energy-efficient and designed for long-term living
*   Turnkey-ready for full-time use, vacation rental, or hybrid investment
*   A rare blend of privacy, security, and livability in the heart of the Caribbean

Schedule your private viewing today. Villa Victoria – Freedom to live beautifully.

          " Nestled along the scenic fairways of the Puerto Aventuras golf course, Villa Victoria is a refined four-bedroom residence offering privacy, tranquility, and effortless living. Designed with intention and care, this home is situated within one of the most established gated communities in the Riviera Maya, blending nature, leisure, and comfort in perfect harmony.



Ideal for families, remote professionals, or those seeking a peaceful base to enjoy the beauty and amenities of the Caribbean coast.



What Makes This Property Special




Light-Filled Living Spaces

With expansive windows, high ceilings, and premium materials, the home welcomes natural light and provides a seamless transition between indoor and outdoor areas, making it ideal for year-round Caribbean living.





Chef-Inspired Kitchen

Featuring granite countertops, stainless steel appliances, and a professional-grade gas cooktop, the kitchen is both functional and beautiful, ideally suited for both everyday meals and entertaining guests.





Private Pool & Lush Gardens

The outdoor space includes a two-tiered swimming pool with shaded areas and a shallow zone for children. Mature greenery provides natural privacy and a serene atmosphere for relaxing or hosting.





Elegant Primary Suite

Unwind in your spacious master bedroom with a spa-style bathroom featuring a jacuzzi tub, dual sinks, and a private terrace overlooking the golf course.





Sustainable, Thoughtful Design

Villa Victoria is solar-equipped with 12 rooftop panels, has its own water well for irrigation and pool, and includes hurricane shutters discreetly tucked away when not in use. A raised foundation adds further protection and peace of mind.





Magical Evenings

As the sun sets, the villa is bathed in a soft glow, perfect for evening dips, gatherings with loved ones, or simply enjoying a quiet night under the stars.






The Puerto Aventuras Lifestyle



This secure, master-planned community offers an unmatched coastal experience:




Access to white-sand beaches and calm Caribbean waters



Private marina for yachts and sailing



Golf course, tennis courts, fitness studios, and yoga



A vibrant town center with shops, restaurants, and bilingual schools



Family-friendly and pet-friendly environment with walkable streets



High-speed internet for seamless remote work



Minutes to Tulum, cenotes, ancient ruins, and eco-adventures




Why Choose Villa Victoria




Located in one of the Riviera Maya’s safest and most desirable neighborhoods



 Energy-efficient and designed for long-term living



 Turnkey-ready for full-time use, vacation rental, or hybrid investment



 A rare blend of privacy, security, and livability in the heart of the Caribbean




Schedule your private viewing today. Villa Victoria – Freedom to live beautifully."

#### Property Description

Discover the most exclusive beachfront estates in Cancun’s Hotel Zone, perfectly positioned on the best stretch of white sand beach. This extraordinary villa offers over 1,600 m² of construction on a 1,000 m² lot, plus expansive private beachfront.

Designed for ultimate comfort and entertainment, the home features 6 spacious bedrooms with ensuite baths, an expansive swimming pool, and a welcoming jacuzzi, two full kitchens (chef’s kitchen & auxiliary kitchen), gym, home theater, offices, and multiple living and dining areas, including one right on the beach.

Enjoy resort-style amenities with one of the rare private docks in the area, equipped with a palapa-covered lounge, boat, and jet ski lifts, and spectacular underwater lighting.

Additional highlights include solar panels, smart home technology, and hurricane-proof glass, 24-hour gated security, and parking for up to 13 vehicles.

This villa is a rare opportunity to own a private Caribbean retreat with unparalleled luxury, privacy, and direct access to the turquoise waters of Cancun.

What Buyers Ask About Marina Front Real Estate
----------------------------------------------

What does marina-front real estate mean in Mexico?

Marina-front real estate in Mexico usually refers to property positioned along a marina, canal, dock area, or marina-view waterfront, but the exact meaning depends on the listing. A marina-front condo may offer water views and access to community amenities without a private dock. A canal-front home in Puerto Aventuras may involve direct water frontage and dock-related questions. A Puerto Cancun residence may be tied to marina access, canals, golf, retail, beach club amenities, or a separate marina arrangement. Marina-front property is different from beachfront property because the buyer is usually evaluating calm-water setting, boat access, canal infrastructure, dock rules, marina fees, and community design. Before relying on any boating benefit, verify written rights, transferability, fees, restrictions, and maintenance responsibilities.

Which Mexico marina-front areas should buyers compare first?

Buyers should usually compare Puerto Cancun and Puerto Aventuras first when using this Marina Front page. Puerto Cancun is a master-planned waterfront community in Cancun, with marina access, canals, golf, retail, beach-club amenities, restaurants, and proximity to both downtown Cancun and the Hotel Zone. Puerto Aventuras is an established Riviera Maya marina community with canal-front homes, marina-view condos, golf, restaurants, beaches, and boating infrastructure inside a gated residential and resort setting. The live page may also include marina-oriented listings in places such as Costa Palmas or Yucalpeten Resort Marina, but Puerto Cancun and Puerto Aventuras are the clearest reference points for buyers comparing Mexican Caribbean marina-front ownership. The right choice depends on lifestyle, access, property type, and boating needs.

How does Puerto Cancun marina-front real estate compare with Puerto Aventuras?

Puerto Cancun is generally more connected to Cancun's city services, Hotel Zone access, retail, restaurants, golf, and newer condominium inventory, while Puerto Aventuras offers a more self-contained Riviera Maya marina community with canal-front homes, condos, land, and boating activity. In Puerto Cancun, buyers often compare residences near the marina, canal homes, golf views, beach-club access, and branded or pre-construction condo buildings. In Puerto Aventuras, buyers often compare homes and condos along the marina canals, Phase 4 opportunities, dock-related property questions, golf-course areas, and nearby beach access. Neither option is automatically better. Puerto Cancun may suit buyers who want Cancun connectivity, while Puerto Aventuras may suit buyers who want a more resort-residential marina setting along the Riviera Maya corridor.

Do marina-front homes in Mexico include a private dock or boat slip?

No, marina-front homes in Mexico do not automatically include a private dock or boat slip. Some canal-front homes may have dock structures or water access, while some marina-view condos may rely on separate marina slips, community docks, memberships, waitlists, or rental arrangements. In Puerto Cancun, the official marina identifies Clubhouse Dock, Dock 7 for Marina Condos and Canal Homes, and Dock 38 for personal watercraft, but access and availability still need written verification. In Puerto Aventuras, the official marina identifies North Marina and South Marina slip areas, but slip rights, vessel size, marina fees, transferability, and rules are still property-specific. Buyers should verify dock permits, slip rights, boat size limits, seawall condition, storm procedures, insurance, maintenance obligations, and marina regulations before closing.

Can foreigners buy marina-front property in Puerto Cancun or Puerto Aventuras?

Yes, foreigners can buy marina-front property in Puerto Cancun and Puerto Aventuras, but many residential purchases are structured through a fideicomiso because both areas are within Mexico's coastal restricted zone. A fideicomiso is a bank trust commonly used for foreign ownership of residential property in restricted coastal and border areas. The bank holds title as trustee, while the foreign buyer holds beneficiary rights under the trust terms. Marina-front purchases may require extra review because the property can involve waterfront boundaries, dock or slip arrangements, marina rules, HOA documents, insurance, and environmental or construction considerations. Buyers should work with qualified legal counsel, a Notario Publico, and the appropriate bank trustee. Christie's Real Estate Mexico can help coordinate next steps with professionals who review ownership and closing documents.

What property types are common in Mexico marina-front listings?

Common marina-front property types in Mexico include marina-view condos, penthouses, canal-front homes, waterfront villas, canal-front land, multi-unit buildings, pre-construction residences, and some rental-oriented properties. Puerto Cancun inventory often leans toward condos, penthouses, branded residences, new-construction or pre-construction buildings, and homes connected to marina, canal, golf, and retail amenities. Puerto Aventuras often includes canal-front homes, marina-view condos, penthouses, boutique residential buildings, Phase 4 opportunities, waterfront land, and occasional multi-unit assets. Each property type has a different ownership profile. Condos may simplify exterior maintenance but come with HOA rules. Homes and land can offer more control, but they usually require deeper review of dock rights, seawalls, utilities, permits, insurance, staffing, and maintenance.

What due diligence matters for marina-front land or pre-construction residences?

Marina-front land and pre-construction residences require deeper due diligence than a finished resale property. Buyers should review title, survey, boundaries, land status, zoning, permits, environmental conditions, marina or canal rights, seawall requirements, utility availability, design approvals, HOA formation, delivery timelines, payment schedule, developer obligations, warranties, cancellation language, and what is included in the purchase price. In Puerto Cancun, this can matter for pre-construction residences and marina-adjacent buildings. In Puerto Aventuras, it can matter for Phase 4, canal-front lots, and new marina-view condo projects. Renderings, projected delivery dates, rental assumptions, or future amenity promises should be supported by written documentation. Qualified legal, technical, tax, insurance, and construction professionals should review the details before funds are released.

Can I rent out a marina-front property in Mexico as a vacation rental?

Some marina-front properties in Mexico may be suitable for vacation rental use, but permission should be verified before purchase. Rental use can depend on zoning, municipal requirements, Quintana Roo tourism registration, tax obligations, HOA bylaws, building rules, marina or community rules, platform policies, insurance, and property management agreements. A Puerto Cancun condo, Puerto Aventuras canal-front home, marina-view penthouse, multi-unit building, or pre-construction residence may each have different rules and operating costs. Investors should request written rental policies, review any available operating history, and compare realistic expenses such as management, cleaning, utilities, HOA fees, marina fees, repairs, insurance, taxes, platform costs, reserves, and vacancy. Treat projected income, cap rate, or ROI language as a starting point for due diligence, not a guaranteed result.

What should buyers verify before making an offer on marina-front real estate in Mexico?

Before making an offer, buyers should verify the property rights, boating rights, ownership structure, operating costs, and physical condition of the marina-front property. Key items include title, liens, fideicomiso requirements, survey, boundaries, HOA documents, community rules, marina rules, dock or slip rights, transferability, vessel size rules, marina fees, seawall condition, canal maintenance, insurance, storm planning, utilities, access, parking, rental policies, permits, closing costs, and property condition. In Puerto Cancun, review marina access, building rules, golf or beach-club costs, pre-construction terms, and view or amenity assumptions. In Puerto Aventuras, review canal frontage, dock rights, Phase 4 details, HOA rules, and marina regulations. Christie's Real Estate Mexico can help buyers compare listings and coordinate property-specific due diligence with qualified professionals.

#### Property Description

Penthouse Canopia is a two-bedroom penthouse in La Veleta, Tulum, designed for buyers who value privacy, architectural character, and a strong connection to the surrounding jungle environment. Set within a boutique building of only three residences, the property offers a quieter residential setting while remaining within easy reach of Tulum’s established dining, wellness, and beach scene.

The residence features a well-balanced layout with two bedrooms and two and a half bathrooms, emphasizing open living spaces and natural light. The design prioritizes indoor and outdoor integration, allowing the living and dining areas to flow seamlessly toward exterior spaces. Thoughtful detailing and a restrained material palette create a comfortable, functional environment suited for both full-time living and extended stays.

A defining feature of the property is its private rooftop terrace, designed as an elevated outdoor living area. Here, a plunge pool, sun lounge, and shaded seating areas overlook the surrounding jungle canopy, offering panoramic views and a high level of privacy. This rooftop space extends the usable living area and creates a setting that is equally suited for personal use or hosting.

La Veleta continues to attract buyers seeking a balance between accessibility and a more residential atmosphere within Tulum. With strong demand for well-designed vacation rentals, properties of this scale and layout are positioned to perform well in the rental market while also serving as a comfortable private residence.

#### Property Description

Set directly along the Caribbean coastline, this beachfront condo offers a refined residential experience designed for buyers seeking comfort and quality in one of Mexico’s most desirable coastal locations. Clean architectural lines, high-end materials, and a thoughtful layout create a space that feels both elevated and highly functional for everyday living or extended stays by the sea.

The great Room is designed as an open-concept space that connects the kitchen, dining, and living areas, framed by floor-to-ceiling sliding glass doors that bring in natural light and open directly to the terrace. Finishes have been carefully selected, including large-format travertine-style flooring, polished Chukum walls, recessed architectural lighting, and solid wood construction throughout. The kitchen features custom white oak cabinetry, high-end natural quartzite stone countertops, and premium SMEG appliances. The residence is delivered fully furnished with custom-made pieces and curated décor, offering a cohesive and move-in-ready environment. Direct private elevator access enhances both convenience and privacy, while two assigned parking spaces add everyday practicality.

Outdoor living is a central feature of the property, with a covered terrace designed for both relaxation and entertaining. A dedicated lounge area and outdoor dining space with a built-in barbecue extend the usable living area, while spa-inspired bathrooms include double rainfall showers, built-in niches, and matte black fixtures that reflect a consistent design language throughout the home.

Ownership is complemented by a comprehensive range of resort-style amenities, including a private beach club, adult and family pools, fitness center, spa, and a dedicated kids club. On-site dining and social options include restaurants, a sushi bar, juice bar, gourmet market, café, ice cream parlor, and a speakeasy-style lounge. Additional features such as indoor basketball and paddle courts, a sports bar, and access to golfing create a well-rounded lifestyle offering within a fully serviced beachfront community.

#### Property Description

Directly on the beachfront in Bahía Tankah, this three-bedroom penthouse at KAOBA places the Caribbean Sea at the center of the living experience. Positioned within a well-regarded coastal community just outside Tulum, the building sits steps from the sand, offering uninterrupted access to the shoreline and wide, open beach views that define this stretch of coastline.

The residence spans a total of 281.24 m² (3,027 ft²), with 163.10 m² (1,756 ft²) of interior living space. The main level includes a 24.25 m² (261 ft²) terrace and a 6.90 m² (74 ft²) balcony, both oriented to capture the coastal setting. Inside, the layout features three bedrooms, three full bathrooms, and two half bathrooms, along with a central living and dining area designed to maximize natural light and connection to the outdoors. The unit is equipped with reverse osmosis filtration, providing clean, drinkable water directly within the residence.

Above, the private rooftop garden measures 77.12 m² (830 ft²) and functions as an independent outdoor living area. It includes a plunge pool, lounge space, and a wood-fired oven, creating a setting for entertaining or relaxing with elevated views over the surrounding coastline. The separation between levels allows for both privacy and flexibility in how the space is used.

KAOBA is a boutique beachfront building with a limited number of residences, offering a more private residential environment within Bahía Tankah. Residents have direct beach access along with amenities that include a beachfront pool, rooftop sunset pool, gym, bar, lobby area, and 24-hour security. The community is known for its natural setting and lower density, providing a quieter alternative to central Tulum while remaining within easy driving distance of dining, services, and attractions.

#### Property Description

Set within the KAOBA oceanfront development in Bahía Tankah, this three-bedroom condominium offers a well-considered layout that connects indoor living with both Caribbean views and surrounding jungle landscape. Part of a boutique collection of just 14 residences, the building emphasizes privacy, low density, and a direct relationship with its natural coastal setting just outside Tulum.

The residence spans a total of 193.12 m² (2,078 ft²), including 159.78 m² (1,719 ft²) of interior space. A 24.44 m² (263 ft²) terrace and an additional 6.90 m² (74 ft²) balcony extend the main living areas, creating a seamless indoor-outdoor flow. The floor plan includes three bedrooms, three full bathrooms, and a guest half bathroom, offering a functional layout suited for both personal use and hosting.

A private plunge pool adds an additional layer of comfort to the outdoor space, providing a more intimate alternative to shared amenities. The distribution of space supports both relaxed day-to-day living and longer stays, with clear separation between social areas and private sleeping quarters.

Residents of KAOBA benefit from a range of shared features including direct beach access, rooftop and beachfront pools, a gym, 24-hour security, and energy-efficient systems. Bahía Tankah is known for its quieter coastline, offering a more private environment while remaining within convenient driving distance of Tulum’s dining, services, and cultural attractions.

#### Property Description

Positioned directly on the beachfront within Tulum’s highly sought-after hotel zone, Lot 28 presents a rare opportunity to acquire a fully operational 21-room boutique hotel in one of the most supply-constrained coastal markets in Mexico. Set on approximately 1,000 m² (10,764 ft²) of prime beachfront land with 1,600 m² (17,222 ft²) of existing construction, the property offers immediate entry into a market where new beachfront development is increasingly limited.

The hotel is delivered as a turnkey hospitality asset, with existing infrastructure, operational systems, and the option to retain current staffing for continuity. The layout supports a boutique guest experience with direct beach access, allowing for seamless operation from day one without the delays and complexities of ground-up construction. Its scale and footprint provide flexibility for both independent operation and brand affiliation.

This stretch of Tulum’s coastline remains one of the most tightly held areas, known for consistent demand driven by international tourism, wellness travel, and experiential hospitality. The property’s beachfront positioning creates a strong foundation for enhancing guest experience and driving revenue through thoughtful upgrades or repositioning.

For investors and operators, the opportunity lies in unlocking additional value through rebranding, operational refinement, and the introduction of complementary amenities such as a beach club, spa, or rooftop concept. With limited comparable inventory and a built asset already in place, Lot 28 represents a strategic acquisition for those looking to establish or expand a presence in Tulum’s beachfront hospitality market.

#### Property Description

Casa 28 de Abril Norte is a thoughtfully designed luxury residence in Colonia San Antonio, one of San Miguel de Allende’s most established residential neighborhoods, just a short walk from Centro. Built with traditional adobe construction and refined contemporary finishes, the home offers a balanced living experience that reflects both local character and modern comfort. Set on a 495 square meter lot or approximately 5,328 square feet, the property features approximately 900 square meters of total construction or about 9,688 square feet, including terraces and covered outdoor areas.

The layout includes five well-proportioned bedrooms, each with its own fireplace, along with radiant floor heating throughout the main living areas on both levels, creating a comfortable environment year-round. The gourmet kitchen is equipped with premium Miele appliances and a Sub-Zero refrigerator, designed for both everyday use and entertaining. A dedicated home office, currently adapted from one of the bedrooms, provides flexibility for remote work or private study. The home is offered furnished and includes practical features such as a garage for two vehicles, washer and dryer, and a comprehensive water purification system.

Outdoor living is a central feature of the property, with multiple terraces offering open views across the surrounding neighborhood. The pool and jacuzzi are both solar heated and utilize advanced zeolite filtration systems, supporting improved water quality and efficiency. A private courtyard, fountain, and landscaped areas create a calm and functional outdoor setting, while a separate casita with independent access adds value for guests, extended family, or rental use. A private gym further enhances the property’s day-to-day livability.

The home is equipped with a robust infrastructure that supports long-term ownership, including a solar water heater, multiple power meters, voltage conditioning, surge protection, and full Wi-Fi coverage. Security has been carefully considered, with perimeter walls, an alarm system, and controlled access points throughout the property. Located within walking distance to Centro, Casa 28 de Abril Norte offers a rare combination of scale, privacy, and proximity in San Miguel de Allende.

#### About Tankah Bay

Tankah Bay, just north of Tulum, blends rustic charm with exclusivity. Protected by an offshore reef, the calm waters are ideal for kayaking, snorkeling, and paddleboarding. The area is rich in biodiversity, with Casa Cenote (Cenote Manatí) nearby, connecting underground rivers to the sea. Tankah is also one of the Riviera Maya’s most important sea turtle nesting beaches, where from March to November, visitors can witness the extraordinary natural spectacle of turtles laying eggs and hatchlings making their way to the ocean.  
  
In a market where prime beachfront land is becoming scarce, this price adjustment creates extraordinary value for investors ready to act. Few opportunities combine such size, exclusivity, natural protection, and beauty with a price advantage of this scale.  
  
Whether envisioned as a boutique hotel, luxury villas, or a private estate, this property offers not only unmatched location and development potential, but also a clear path to strong returns in Tulum’s luxury coastal market.

#### Property Description

Casa Zapote is a contemporary residence set within the gated Villas Caribe community in Bahía Príncipe, part of the Tulum Country Club. Designed to reflect the natural character of the Riviera Maya, the home blends regional materials such as Mayan stone, chukum, and tzalam wood with clean architectural lines. The result is a property that feels connected to its jungle surroundings while offering the comfort and privacy expected in one of Tulum’s most established residential communities.

The home offers approximately 3513 square feet of interior construction (326 square meters) on a 4843 square foot lot (450 square meters), with an additional pool and outdoor area of about 538 square feet (50 square meters). A double-height living area anchors the main floor, creating a bright, open space that connects seamlessly to the dining area and kitchen with pantry and breakfast bar. Large sliding glass doors open to the garden, allowing natural light and ventilation throughout. The layout includes three bedrooms, with a flexible family room upstairs that can function as a fourth bedroom, along with four full bathrooms and two half bathrooms.

Outdoor living is a central feature of the property. The private pool, sunbed area, and dedicated barbecue and dining spaces are designed for both everyday use and entertaining. The primary suite stands out with views over the garden and pool, along with an exterior bathtub positioned on a private terrace, offering a quiet connection to the surrounding greenery. Additional features include a maid’s room with a full bathroom, a laundry room, two parking spaces, and integrated storage areas throughout the home.

Sustainability and long-term efficiency are built into the design, with systems for water recycling, solar energy preparation, and a solar water heater already in place. The property also preserves native vegetation, incorporating relocated endemic trees into its landscaped grounds. Residents of Bahía Príncipe benefit from access to the PGA Riviera Maya Golf Course, beach club, and a range of services and amenities within a secure, master planned environment in Tulum.

What Buyers Ask About Beachfront Real Estate
--------------------------------------------

Can foreigners buy beachfront property in Mexico?

Yes, foreigners can buy beachfront property in Mexico, but many residential purchases are structured through a fideicomiso because coastal property is within Mexico's restricted zone. A fideicomiso is a bank trust commonly used for foreign ownership of residential property within 50 kilometers of the beach or 100 kilometers of the border. The bank holds title as trustee, while the foreign buyer holds beneficiary rights to use, sell, lease, improve, or pass on the property according to the trust terms. Buyers should work with qualified legal counsel, a Notario Publico, and the appropriate bank trustee before closing. Christie's Real Estate Mexico can help you compare beachfront listings and coordinate next steps with professionals who can review title, ownership structure, closing documents, and trust requirements.

What is the difference between beachfront, oceanfront, beach-access, and ocean-view property in Mexico?

The difference matters because these terms do not always mean the same thing. Beachfront usually suggests the property sits directly along the beach or immediately next to the coastal zone. Oceanfront may mean direct water frontage, but in places such as Los Cabos, Puerto Vallarta, Acapulco, or Huatulco it can also involve cliffs, rocks, bays, or elevated terrain rather than walk-out sand. Beach-access property may be near a beach path or shared access point without direct frontage. Ocean-view property may offer strong views but no direct beach rights or access. Buyers should verify the survey, boundaries, access, ZOFEMAT conditions, concessions if applicable, and whether the beach itself is usable, seasonal, public, rocky, swimmable, or subject to environmental rules.

How should buyers compare beachfront real estate in the Mexican Caribbean, Los Cabos, Puerto Vallarta, Acapulco, and Huatulco?

Buyers should compare Mexican beachfront markets by coast, beach type, access, maintenance burden, and intended use. The Mexican Caribbean often appeals to buyers seeking white-sand beaches, turquoise water, reef settings, and resort or vacation-rental infrastructure in markets such as Cancun, Puerto Morelos, Playa del Carmen, Puerto Aventuras, Akumal, and Tulum. Los Cabos is different, with desert landscapes, Sea of Cortez and Pacific exposure, dramatic surf, and some beaches that require careful swimmability review. Puerto Vallarta and Banderas Bay combine beaches, mountain terrain, bay views, and urban services. Acapulco offers bay, cliffside, and Diamante-style settings with strong building-condition questions. Huatulco is more bay-specific, with varied topography, ecological considerations, and lower-density Pacific coast character. The right choice depends on how you will actually use and maintain the property.

What should buyers know about Mexican Caribbean beachfront property?

Mexican Caribbean beachfront property should be evaluated for exact shoreline, reef context, sargassum exposure, building rules, rental compliance, and access. Cancun's Hotel Zone, Puerto Morelos, Playa del Carmen, Puerto Aventuras, Akumal, Tulum, Tankah Bay, Soliman Bay, Jade Bay, Punta Sur, and nearby coastal areas all offer different versions of beachfront living. A condo near Mamita's Beach is a different ownership experience from a villa in Akumal, a boutique hotel in Tankah Bay, or land near Mahahual. Buyers should review title, survey, ZOFEMAT, environmental restrictions, HOA bylaws, rental rules, construction quality, storm preparation, insurance, water, wastewater, and property management. Cancun International Airport, Tulum International Airport, Highway 307, ferry access, and Tren Maya connections can matter, but schedules and travel times should be verified close to purchase.

What should buyers know about beachfront property in Los Cabos?

Beachfront property in Los Cabos should be reviewed beach by beach because the region includes both Sea of Cortez and Pacific-facing coastlines. Some beaches near Cabo San Lucas, San Jose del Cabo, the Tourist Corridor, San Jose Corridor, and the East Cape may support swimming, snorkeling, surfing, or boating, while others can have stronger surf, rocks, undertow, or restricted water use. Los Cabos buyers should compare swimmability, slope, erosion, storm exposure, water infrastructure, road access, HOA rules, master-community costs, golf or beach-club access, and proximity to Los Cabos International Airport. A dramatic oceanfront view is valuable, but it should not replace careful review of title, survey, building setbacks, insurance, construction standards, utility systems, and long-term salt-air maintenance.

How is Puerto Vallarta beachfront different from other Mexico beach markets?

Puerto Vallarta beachfront is shaped by Banderas Bay, mountain-backed terrain, and a mix of urban, hillside, and south-shore coastal settings. Buyers often compare Marina Vallarta, the Hotel Zone, Conchas Chinas, Amapas, Garza Blanca, Punta Negra, Mismaloya, and nearby bay communities for beach access, views, walkability, privacy, and services. Unlike some flatter Caribbean beach markets, Puerto Vallarta properties may be direct beachfront, hillside ocean-view, bayfront, or beach-access homes with different access and maintenance needs. The official visitor context also points to Puerto Vallarta's position on Banderas Bay and its air access through Puerto Vallarta International Airport. Buyers should evaluate real-world road access, slope, staff and service access, HOA rules, rental permissions, insurance, stormwater management, and whether the property fits personal use, rental use, or longer stays.

What should buyers know about Acapulco beachfront and bay-view property?

Acapulco beachfront and bay-view property should be evaluated through the lens of location, building condition, and coastal resilience. Acapulco includes distinct zones such as Diamante, Golden Zone, Traditional Zone, Pie de la Cuesta, Las Brisas, Brisas Guitarron, Pichilingue, Puerto Marques, Santa Lucia Bay, and Revolcadero. Some luxury properties are true beach-access or beachfront condos, while others are elevated villas with dramatic bay or ocean views. Buyers should review storm history, repairs, structural systems, windows, waterproofing, elevators, reserves, insurance, staff access, HOA documents, title, permits, zoning, and current services. Acapulco International Airport and highway access from Mexico City can affect convenience, but any travel-time assumptions should be checked close to purchase. For rentals, written rules and realistic operating costs matter more than lifestyle appeal alone.

What makes Huatulco beachfront property different?

Huatulco beachfront property is different because the market is organized around bays, beaches, slopes, and environmental context rather than one continuous urban beach strip. The region is known for nine bays and more than 30 beaches across the Oaxaca coast, with areas such as Bahia de Conejos, Playa Arrocito, La Bocana, Playa Salchi, Tangolunda, Santa Cruz, and Chahue offering different terrain and ownership considerations. Some properties may be direct beachfront, while others are ocean-view, hillside, bayfront, or beach-access homes. Buyers should review road access, slope, utilities, water, wastewater, environmental restrictions, building permits, storm exposure, insurance, title, survey, and ZOFEMAT or concession issues where applicable. Huatulco International Airport supports regional access, but the practical ownership question is how easily owners, guests, staff, supplies, and maintenance teams can reach the property.

Should I buy a beachfront condo, villa, land parcel, or boutique hotel in Mexico?

The right property type depends on how you plan to use the asset and how much operational responsibility you want. A beachfront condo can be practical for seasonal use because exterior maintenance, amenities, security features, and some storm preparation are usually managed through an HOA. A villa may offer more privacy, outdoor space, and control, but it usually requires more direct responsibility for staffing, pool care, landscaping, repairs, insurance, and salt-air maintenance. A land parcel requires deeper review of title, zoning, buildability, services, environmental rules, access, and coastal setbacks. A boutique hotel or multi-unit property is both real estate and an operating business, so buyers should review licenses, financial statements, staff, taxes, maintenance, platform accounts, and management systems before relying on projected income.

What due diligence is most important before buying beachfront property in Mexico?

The most important beachfront due diligence includes title, survey, boundaries, fideicomiso structure, liens, ZOFEMAT, concessions, zoning, permits, environmental restrictions, HOA documents, rental rules, insurance, utilities, water, wastewater, access, structural condition, storm history, and closing costs. For condos, review HOA budgets, reserves, insurance, guest policies, rental restrictions, planned assessments, and building maintenance. For villas, add roof, windows, terraces, waterproofing, pool systems, staff access, security features, landscaping, salt-air corrosion, and storm preparation. For land, hotels, or mixed-use properties, confirm permitted use, licenses, buildability, operating history, tax obligations, and environmental approvals. Buyers should work with qualified legal, tax, accounting, insurance, environmental, and technical professionals before closing. Christie's Real Estate Mexico can help compare listings and coordinate next steps, but professional review should drive the final decision.

What Buyers Ask About Beachfront Real Estate
--------------------------------------------

Can foreigners buy beachfront property in Mexico?

Yes, foreigners can buy beachfront property in Mexico, but many residential purchases are structured through a fideicomiso because coastal property is within Mexico's restricted zone. A fideicomiso is a bank trust commonly used for foreign ownership of residential property within 50 kilometers of the beach or 100 kilometers of the border. The bank holds title as trustee, while the foreign buyer holds beneficiary rights to use, sell, lease, improve, or pass on the property according to the trust terms. Buyers should work with qualified legal counsel, a Notario Publico, and the appropriate bank trustee before closing. Christie's Real Estate Mexico can help you compare beachfront listings and coordinate next steps with professionals who can review title, ownership structure, closing documents, and trust requirements.

What is the difference between beachfront, oceanfront, beach-access, and ocean-view property in Mexico?

The difference matters because these terms do not always mean the same thing. Beachfront usually suggests the property sits directly along the beach or immediately next to the coastal zone. Oceanfront may mean direct water frontage, but in places such as Los Cabos, Puerto Vallarta, Acapulco, or Huatulco it can also involve cliffs, rocks, bays, or elevated terrain rather than walk-out sand. Beach-access property may be near a beach path or shared access point without direct frontage. Ocean-view property may offer strong views but no direct beach rights or access. Buyers should verify the survey, boundaries, access, ZOFEMAT conditions, concessions if applicable, and whether the beach itself is usable, seasonal, public, rocky, swimmable, or subject to environmental rules.

How should buyers compare beachfront real estate in the Mexican Caribbean, Los Cabos, Puerto Vallarta, Acapulco, and Huatulco?

Buyers should compare Mexican beachfront markets by coast, beach type, access, maintenance burden, and intended use. The Mexican Caribbean often appeals to buyers seeking white-sand beaches, turquoise water, reef settings, and resort or vacation-rental infrastructure in markets such as Cancun, Puerto Morelos, Playa del Carmen, Puerto Aventuras, Akumal, and Tulum. Los Cabos is different, with desert landscapes, Sea of Cortez and Pacific exposure, dramatic surf, and some beaches that require careful swimmability review. Puerto Vallarta and Banderas Bay combine beaches, mountain terrain, bay views, and urban services. Acapulco offers bay, cliffside, and Diamante-style settings with strong building-condition questions. Huatulco is more bay-specific, with varied topography, ecological considerations, and lower-density Pacific coast character. The right choice depends on how you will actually use and maintain the property.

What should buyers know about Mexican Caribbean beachfront property?

Mexican Caribbean beachfront property should be evaluated for exact shoreline, reef context, sargassum exposure, building rules, rental compliance, and access. Cancun's Hotel Zone, Puerto Morelos, Playa del Carmen, Puerto Aventuras, Akumal, Tulum, Tankah Bay, Soliman Bay, Jade Bay, Punta Sur, and nearby coastal areas all offer different versions of beachfront living. A condo near Mamita's Beach is a different ownership experience from a villa in Akumal, a boutique hotel in Tankah Bay, or land near Mahahual. Buyers should review title, survey, ZOFEMAT, environmental restrictions, HOA bylaws, rental rules, construction quality, storm preparation, insurance, water, wastewater, and property management. Cancun International Airport, Tulum International Airport, Highway 307, ferry access, and Tren Maya connections can matter, but schedules and travel times should be verified close to purchase.

What should buyers know about beachfront property in Los Cabos?

Beachfront property in Los Cabos should be reviewed beach by beach because the region includes both Sea of Cortez and Pacific-facing coastlines. Some beaches near Cabo San Lucas, San Jose del Cabo, the Tourist Corridor, San Jose Corridor, and the East Cape may support swimming, snorkeling, surfing, or boating, while others can have stronger surf, rocks, undertow, or restricted water use. Los Cabos buyers should compare swimmability, slope, erosion, storm exposure, water infrastructure, road access, HOA rules, master-community costs, golf or beach-club access, and proximity to Los Cabos International Airport. A dramatic oceanfront view is valuable, but it should not replace careful review of title, survey, building setbacks, insurance, construction standards, utility systems, and long-term salt-air maintenance.

How is Puerto Vallarta beachfront different from other Mexico beach markets?

Puerto Vallarta beachfront is shaped by Banderas Bay, mountain-backed terrain, and a mix of urban, hillside, and south-shore coastal settings. Buyers often compare Marina Vallarta, the Hotel Zone, Conchas Chinas, Amapas, Garza Blanca, Punta Negra, Mismaloya, and nearby bay communities for beach access, views, walkability, privacy, and services. Unlike some flatter Caribbean beach markets, Puerto Vallarta properties may be direct beachfront, hillside ocean-view, bayfront, or beach-access homes with different access and maintenance needs. The official visitor context also points to Puerto Vallarta's position on Banderas Bay and its air access through Puerto Vallarta International Airport. Buyers should evaluate real-world road access, slope, staff and service access, HOA rules, rental permissions, insurance, stormwater management, and whether the property fits personal use, rental use, or longer stays.

What should buyers know about Acapulco beachfront and bay-view property?

Acapulco beachfront and bay-view property should be evaluated through the lens of location, building condition, and coastal resilience. Acapulco includes distinct zones such as Diamante, Golden Zone, Traditional Zone, Pie de la Cuesta, Las Brisas, Brisas Guitarron, Pichilingue, Puerto Marques, Santa Lucia Bay, and Revolcadero. Some luxury properties are true beach-access or beachfront condos, while others are elevated villas with dramatic bay or ocean views. Buyers should review storm history, repairs, structural systems, windows, waterproofing, elevators, reserves, insurance, staff access, HOA documents, title, permits, zoning, and current services. Acapulco International Airport and highway access from Mexico City can affect convenience, but any travel-time assumptions should be checked close to purchase. For rentals, written rules and realistic operating costs matter more than lifestyle appeal alone.

What makes Huatulco beachfront property different?

Huatulco beachfront property is different because the market is organized around bays, beaches, slopes, and environmental context rather than one continuous urban beach strip. The region is known for nine bays and more than 30 beaches across the Oaxaca coast, with areas such as Bahia de Conejos, Playa Arrocito, La Bocana, Playa Salchi, Tangolunda, Santa Cruz, and Chahue offering different terrain and ownership considerations. Some properties may be direct beachfront, while others are ocean-view, hillside, bayfront, or beach-access homes. Buyers should review road access, slope, utilities, water, wastewater, environmental restrictions, building permits, storm exposure, insurance, title, survey, and ZOFEMAT or concession issues where applicable. Huatulco International Airport supports regional access, but the practical ownership question is how easily owners, guests, staff, supplies, and maintenance teams can reach the property.

Should I buy a beachfront condo, villa, land parcel, or boutique hotel in Mexico?

The right property type depends on how you plan to use the asset and how much operational responsibility you want. A beachfront condo can be practical for seasonal use because exterior maintenance, amenities, security features, and some storm preparation are usually managed through an HOA. A villa may offer more privacy, outdoor space, and control, but it usually requires more direct responsibility for staffing, pool care, landscaping, repairs, insurance, and salt-air maintenance. A land parcel requires deeper review of title, zoning, buildability, services, environmental rules, access, and coastal setbacks. A boutique hotel or multi-unit property is both real estate and an operating business, so buyers should review licenses, financial statements, staff, taxes, maintenance, platform accounts, and management systems before relying on projected income.

What due diligence is most important before buying beachfront property in Mexico?

The most important beachfront due diligence includes title, survey, boundaries, fideicomiso structure, liens, ZOFEMAT, concessions, zoning, permits, environmental restrictions, HOA documents, rental rules, insurance, utilities, water, wastewater, access, structural condition, storm history, and closing costs. For condos, review HOA budgets, reserves, insurance, guest policies, rental restrictions, planned assessments, and building maintenance. For villas, add roof, windows, terraces, waterproofing, pool systems, staff access, security features, landscaping, salt-air corrosion, and storm preparation. For land, hotels, or mixed-use properties, confirm permitted use, licenses, buildability, operating history, tax obligations, and environmental approvals. Buyers should work with qualified legal, tax, accounting, insurance, environmental, and technical professionals before closing. Christie's Real Estate Mexico can help compare listings and coordinate next steps, but professional review should drive the final decision.

#### Property Description

Casa Noyes is a thoughtfully designed residence in El Cielo Residencial, Playa del Carmen, offering a balance of natural light, functional layout, and seamless indoor-outdoor living just minutes from the Caribbean coastline.

Set within a secure residential community, the home features a double-height entrance that creates a strong architectural introduction while allowing natural light to carry throughout the interior. Large windows in every space bring in surrounding greenery, creating a consistent connection between the home and its environment.

The layout is designed for both everyday living and entertaining. Interior spaces flow naturally from one area to the next, including a dedicated office that integrates easily into the overall design without feeling separate or confined. The sense of openness is complemented by a warm and comfortable atmosphere that makes the home feel both spacious and livable.

Social areas connect directly to the outdoor terrace, where the property opens into a private pool and landscaped backyard. This space functions as a natural extension of the home, well suited for hosting or spending time with family. An additional outdoor area, currently used as a gym, offers flexibility to be adapted into a yoga space, barbecue area, or another use based on the owner’s preferences.

The primary bedroom is positioned to take advantage of the surrounding greenery, with a private terrace overlooking the pool. This creates a quiet, private setting that works equally well for morning use or evening relaxation.

The home is offered turnkey, allowing for immediate use without the need for additional setup. Infrastructure has been carefully considered, including 29 solar panels supported by 3 backup batteries, providing energy efficiency and consistent power. A salt-based water softening system further enhances day-to-day comfort.

Located in El Cielo Residencial, the property offers a secure and established setting with easy access to beach clubs, dining, and services in Playa del Carmen. This combination of privacy, functionality, and location makes Casa Noyes a strong option for both full-time living and long-term value.

          " Casa Noyes is a thoughtfully designed residence in El Cielo Residencial, Playa del Carmen, offering a balance of natural light, functional layout, and seamless indoor-outdoor living just minutes from the Caribbean coastline.

Expert Insights on Living and Investing in Tulum Country Club, Tulum
--------------------------------------------------------------------

Local advisor perspectives on what it is like to live and invest in this sought-after neighborhood.

![Maxime Bertron](https://www.christiesrealestatemexico.com/wp-content/uploads/2025/01/HeadShots-final-7-copy.jpg)

Maxime Bertron•Real Estate Agent

> Tulum Country Club offers a secure, well-maintained environment that invites peace of mind, making it ideal for those seeking safety and tranquility in the Riviera Maya. I have a client who built a home there, and every time I visit, I’m struck by how immaculate everything looks: the greenery, the gardens, the trees. It honestly feels like living in a U.S. golf course community, but surrounded by the beauty of the Mexican Caribbean. The golf itself is superb, offering a PGA-level course, and the whole area has a calm, residential atmosphere.
> 
> One of the biggest highlights is Kay Beach Club, a private beachfront escape with excellent service, fantastic food, and a swimming pool overlooking the Ocean. Families appreciate having a well-known international school right in the community, making daily life even more convenient.
> 
> Suppose you are looking for a peaceful holiday or retirement home, prioritizing security and a lifestyle similar to what you experience back home. In that case, this is the place to feel at ease and truly enjoy your time in Tulum & the Riviera Maya.
